items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of the SpringExtension and JUnit Jupiter
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，转而使用 SpringExtension 和 JUnit Jupiter。

items.source: since 7.0.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起。

items.source: with no replacement as not actively maintained anymore
items.translation: 由于不再积极维护，不进行替换。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，推荐使用SqlBinaryValue和SqlCharacterValue

items.source: RowMapper implementation that converts a row into a new instance of the specified mapped target class.
items.translation: 将行转换为指定映射目标类新实例的RowMapper实现。

items.source: Configuration constants for internal sharing across subpackages.
items.translation: 子包之间内部共享的配置常量。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of direct ResultSet.getSQLXML(int) and Connection.createSQLXML() usage, possibly in combination with a custom SqlValue implementation
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，推荐使用直接调用ResultSet.getSQLXML(int)和 Connection.createSQLXML()，并可能结合自定义的 SqlValue实现使用。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为支持将带有 @DirtiesContext 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 ApplicationContext 标记为 dirty（脏）提供支持。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of SqlBinaryValue and SqlCharacterValue
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，推荐使用SqlBinaryValue和SqlCharacterValue

items.source: as of 6.0.3, in favor of PessimisticLockingFailureException/CannotAcquireLockException
items.translation: 自 6.0.3 版本起，推荐使用 PessimisticLockingFailureException/CannotAcquireLockException

items.source: Resolves arguments of type Map annotated with @MatrixVariable where the annotation does not specify a name.
items.translation: 解析带有未指定名称的 `Map` 类型参数的 `@MatrixVariable` 注解。

items.source: Task implementation defining a Runnable with an initial delay.
items.translation: Task 实现定义了一个带有初始延迟的Runnable。

items.source: A logical conjunction (' && ') request condition that matches a request against a set of header expressions with syntax defined in RequestMapping.headers().
items.translation: 逻辑与 (`' && '`) 请求条件，用于根据在RequestMapping.headers()中定义的语法将请求与一组头表达式进行匹配。

items.source: A logical conjunction (' && ') request condition that matches a request against a set parameter expressions with syntax defined in RequestMapping.params().
items.translation: 逻辑与（`' && '`）请求条件，用于根据在RequestMapping.params()中定义的语法定义的一组参数表达式来匹配请求。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of direct SQLXML usage
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，推荐使用直接 `SQLXML` 用法。

items.source: Resolves argument values of type SemanticApiVersionParser.Version.
items.translation: 解析类型为SemanticApiVersionParser.Version的参数值。

items.source: Strategy interface for loading an ApplicationContext for an integration test managed by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 用于加载由 Spring TestContext Framework 管理的集成测试的ApplicationContext的策略接口。

items.source: Assists with the creation of a CorsConfiguration instance for a given URL path pattern.
items.translation: 协助为给定的 URL 路径模式创建 `CorsConfiguration` 实例。

items.source: Assists with the registration of global, URL pattern based CorsConfiguration mappings.
items.translation: 协助注册基于全局 URL 模式的 CorsConfiguration 映射。

items.source: Convenient implementation of the IntroductionInterceptor interface.
items.translation: 方便实现`IntroductionInterceptor`接口。

items.source: Resolve for @DestinationVariable method parameters.
items.translation: 解析 `@DestinationVariable` 方法参数。

items.source: Extended variant of the standard ApplicationListener interface, exposing further metadata such as the supported event and source type.
items.translation: 标准 `ApplicationListener` 接口的扩展变体，暴露了更多元数据，例如支持的事件和源类型。

items.source: Strategy interface for resolving method parameters into argument values in the context of a given Message.
items.translation: 用于在给定Message上下文中将方法参数解析为参数值的策略接口。

items.source: Resolver for @Header arguments.
items.translation: 用于 `@Header` 参数的解析器。

items.source: Extended interface for a Resource to be written to an HTTP response.
items.translation: 用于写入 HTTP 响应的Resource扩展接口。

items.source: Resolves arguments annotated with @MatrixVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有@MatrixVariable注解的参数。

items.source: ApiVersionResolver that extracts the version from a media type parameter found in the Accept or Content-Type headers.
items.translation: 提取 Accept 或 Content-Type 标头中发现的媒体类型参数中的版本的ApiVersionResolver。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @RequestAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: A logical disjunction (' || ') request condition that matches a request against a set of RequestMethods.
items.translation: 一个逻辑或 (' || ') 请求条件，用于将请求与一组 RequestMethods 进行匹配。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @SessionAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@SessionAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer that increments the maximum value of a given Sybase table with the equivalent of an auto-increment column.
items.translation: DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer 用于通过相当于自增列的方式，增加给定 Sybase 表的最大值。

items.source: No-op resolver for method arguments of type Continuation.
items.translation: Continuation 类型方法参数的无操作解析器。

items.source: Assertions on cookies of the response.
items.translation: 对响应 Cookie 的断言。

items.source: Assertions on headers of the response.
items.translation: 对响应头的断言。

items.source: Assertions on the response status.
items.translation: 对响应状态的断言。

items.source: Defines a builder for a request.
items.translation: 定义请求的构建器。

items.source: Contract for access to session counters.
items.translation: 会话计数器访问权限的合同。

items.source: Resolves ServerWebExchange-related method argument values of the following types: ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder or UriComponentsBuilder -- for building URL's relative to the current request
items.translation: 解决以下类型的与 `ServerWebExchange` 相关的方法参数值： ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder 或 UriComponentsBuilder —— 用于构建相对于当前请求的 URL

items.source: HandlerResultHandler that encapsulates the view resolution algorithm supporting the following return types: Void, void, or no value -- default view name String -- view name unless @ModelAttribute-annotated View -- View to render with Model -- attributes to add to the model Map -- attributes to add to the model Rendering -- use case driven API for view resolution @ModelAttribute -- attribute for the model Non-simple value -- attribute for the model
items.translation: 封装视图解析算法的 HandlerResultHandler，支持以下返回类型： Void、void 或无值 -- 默认视图名称 String -- 视图名称，除非带有 @ModelAttribute 注解 View -- 用于渲染的视图 Model -- 添加到模型中的属性 Map -- 添加到模型中的属性 Rendering -- 视图解析的用例驱动 API @ModelAttribute -- 模型属性 非简单值 -- 模型属性

items.source: Resolves HttpEntity and RequestEntity method argument values, as well as return values of type HttpEntity, ResponseEntity, ErrorResponse and ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 解析 `HttpEntity` 和 `RequestEntity` 的方法参数值，以及类型为 `HttpEntity`、`ResponseEntity`、`ErrorResponse` 和 `ProblemDetail` 的返回值。

items.source: Encapsulates a Java Type, providing access to supertypes, interfaces, and generic parameters along with the ability to ultimately resolve to a Class.
items.translation: 封装一个 Java Type，提供对supertypes、interfaces和generic parameters的访问，以及最终resolve到 Class的能力。

items.source: Base class for MessageCondition's that pre-declares abstract methods AbstractMessageCondition.getContent() and AbstractMessageCondition.getToStringInfix() in order to provide implementations of AbstractMessageCondition.equals(Object), AbstractMessageCondition.hashCode(), and AbstractMessageCondition.toString().
items.translation: `MessageCondition` 的基类，预先声明了抽象方法 AbstractMessageCondition.getContent() 和 AbstractMessageCondition.getToStringInfix()，以便为 AbstractMessageCondition.equals(Object)、AbstractMessageCondition.hashCode() 和 AbstractMessageCondition.toString() 提供实现。

items.source: WebFilter that handles CORS preflight requests and intercepts CORS simple and actual requests thanks to a CorsProcessor implementation (DefaultCorsProcessor by default) in order to add the relevant CORS response headers (like Access-Control-Allow-Origin) using the provided CorsConfigurationSource (for example an UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource instance.
items.translation: 处理 CORS 预检请求并拦截 CORS 简单和实际请求的WebFilter，这得益于一个CorsProcessor实现（默认为DefaultCorsProcessor），以便使用提供的CorsConfigurationSource（例如一个UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource实例）添加相关的 CORS 响应头（如Access-Control-Allow-Origin）。

items.source: An IdGenerator that uses SecureRandom for the initial seed and Random thereafter, instead of calling UUID.randomUUID() every time as JdkIdGenerator does.
items.translation: 一个使用 `SecureRandom` 作为初始种子，随后使用 `Random` 的 `IdGenerator`，而不是像 `JdkIdGenerator` 那样每次都调用 `UUID.randomUUID()`。

items.source: Allows a Converter, GenericConverter or ConverterFactory to conditionally execute based on attributes of the source and target TypeDescriptor.
items.translation: 允许根据 `source` 和 `target` TypeDescriptor 的属性，有条件地执行 Converter、GenericConverter 或 ConverterFactory。

items.source: Handles return values of type HttpEntity, ResponseEntity, HttpHeaders, ErrorResponse, and ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 处理类型为HttpEntity、ResponseEntity、HttpHeaders、ErrorResponse和ProblemDetail的返回值。

items.source: WebMergedContextConfiguration encapsulates the merged context configuration declared on a test class and all of its superclasses and enclosing classes via @ContextConfiguration, @WebAppConfiguration, @ActiveProfiles, and @TestPropertySource.
items.translation: WebMergedContextConfiguration 封装了测试类及其所有父类和包含类上声明的*合并*上下文配置，这些配置通过@ContextConfiguration、@WebAppConfiguration、@ActiveProfiles和@TestPropertySource注解声明。

items.source: LinkedHashMap subclass representing annotation attribute key-value pairs as read by AnnotationUtils, AnnotatedElementUtils, and Spring's reflection- and ASM-based AnnotationMetadata implementations.
items.translation: LinkedHashMap 子类，表示注解属性键值对，这些键值对由 AnnotationUtils、AnnotatedElementUtils 以及 Spring 基于反射和 ASM 的 AnnotationMetadata 实现读取。

items.source: AnnotationAwareOrderComparator is an extension of OrderComparator that supports Spring's Ordered interface as well as the @Order and @Priority annotations, with an order value provided by an Ordered instance overriding a statically defined annotation value (if any).
items.translation: AnnotationAwareOrderComparator 是 OrderComparator 的扩展，它支持 Spring 的 Ordered 接口以及 @Order 和 @Priority 注解，其中由 Ordered 实例提供的顺序值会覆盖静态定义的注解值（如果有的话）。

items.source: Specialization of @Component for classes that declare @ExceptionHandler, @InitBinder, or @ModelAttribute methods to be shared across multiple @Controller classes.
items.translation: 用于声明 `@ExceptionHandler`、`@InitBinder` 或 `@ModelAttribute` 方法的类的 `@Component` 特化，以便在多个 `@Controller` 类之间共享。

items.source: DelegatingSmartContextLoader is a concrete implementation of AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader that delegates to a GenericXmlContextLoader (or a GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader if Groovy is present in the classpath) and an AnnotationConfigContextLoader.
items.translation: DelegatingSmartContextLoader 是 AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 的一个具体实现，它委托给一个 GenericXmlContextLoader（如果类路径中存在 Groovy，则委托给 GenericGroovyXmlContextLoader）和一个 AnnotationConfigContextLoader。

items.source: HttpExchangeAdapterDecorator that suppresses the HttpClientErrorException.NotFound exception raised on a 404 response and returns a ResponseEntity with the status set to HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND status, or null from NotFoundRestClientAdapterDecorator.exchangeForBody(HttpRequestValues, ParameterizedTypeReference).
items.translation: HttpExchangeAdapterDecorator 会抑制在 404 响应上抛出的HttpClientErrorException.NotFound异常，并返回一个状态设置为HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND的ResponseEntity，或者从NotFoundRestClientAdapterDecorator.exchangeForBody(HttpRequestValues, ParameterizedTypeReference)返回null。

items.source: HttpExchangeAdapterDecorator that suppresses the WebClientResponseException.NotFound exception resulting from 404 responses and returns a ResponseEntity with the status set to HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND status, or an empty Mono from NotFoundWebClientAdapterDecorator.exchangeForBodyMono(HttpRequestValues, ParameterizedTypeReference).
items.translation: HttpExchangeAdapterDecorator 会抑制由 404 响应导致的WebClientResponseException.NotFound 异常，并返回一个状态设置为HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND的ResponseEntity，或者来自NotFoundWebClientAdapterDecorator.exchangeForBodyMono(HttpRequestValues, ParameterizedTypeReference)的空Mono。

items.source: Editor for Resource descriptors, to automatically convert String locations for example, file:C:/myfile.txt or classpath:myfile.txt to Resource properties instead of using a String location property.
items.translation: Editor 用于 Resource 描述符，以自动将 String 位置（例如 file:C:/myfile.txt 或 classpath:myfile.txt）转换为 Resource 属性，而不是使用 String 位置属性。

items.source: @SpringJUnitWebConfig is a composed annotation that combines @ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class) from JUnit Jupiter with @ContextConfiguration and @WebAppConfiguration from the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: `@SpringJUnitWebConfig` 是一个组合注解，它结合了来自 JUnit Jupiter 的@ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class)以及来自Spring TestContext 框架的@ContextConfiguration和@WebAppConfiguration。

items.source: TestContextAnnotationUtils is a collection of utility methods that complements the standard support already available in MergedAnnotations, AnnotationUtils, and AnnotatedElementUtils, while transparently honoring @NestedTestConfiguration semantics.
items.translation: TestContextAnnotationUtils 是一组实用方法，补充了 MergedAnnotations、AnnotationUtils 和 AnnotatedElementUtils 中已有的标准支持，同时透明地遵循 @NestedTestConfiguration 的语义。

items.source: @TestPropertySource is an annotation that can be applied to a test class to configure the TestPropertySource.locations() of properties files and inlined TestPropertySource.properties() to be added to the Environment's set of PropertySources for an ApplicationContext for integration tests.
items.translation: `@TestPropertySource` 是一个注解，可应用于测试类以配置要添加到集成测试的 ApplicationContext 的 Environment 的 PropertySources 集合中的属性文件的 TestPropertySource.locations() 和内联的 TestPropertySource.properties()。

items.source: WebDelegatingSmartContextLoader is a concrete implementation of AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader that delegates to a GenericXmlWebContextLoader (or a GenericGroovyXmlWebContextLoader if Groovy is present on the classpath) and an AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader.
items.translation: WebDelegatingSmartContextLoader 是 AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 的一个具体实现，它委托给一个 GenericXmlWebContextLoader（如果类路径中存在 Groovy，则委托给 GenericGroovyXmlWebContextLoader）和一个 AnnotationConfigWebContextLoader。

items.source: Base class for concrete, full-fledged BeanDefinition classes, factoring out common properties of GenericBeanDefinition, RootBeanDefinition, and ChildBeanDefinition.
items.translation: 具体、完整的BeanDefinition类的基类，提取了GenericBeanDefinition、RootBeanDefinition和ChildBeanDefinition的公共属性。

items.source: Extension of AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor which implements BeanFactoryAware, adds exposure of the original target class for each proxied bean (AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE), and participates in an externally enforced target-class mode for any given bean (AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE).
items.translation: 扩展了实现 BeanFactoryAware 的 AbstractAdvisingBeanPostProcessor，为每个代理 bean 暴露原始目标类（AutoProxyUtils.ORIGINAL_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE），并参与任何给定 bean 的外部强制目标类模式（AutoProxyUtils.PRESERVE_TARGET_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE）。

items.source: A base class for RequestCondition types providing implementations of AbstractRequestCondition.equals(Object), AbstractRequestCondition.hashCode(), and AbstractRequestCondition.toString().
items.translation: 一个用于 `RequestCondition` 类型的基类，提供对 AbstractRequestCondition.equals(Object)、AbstractRequestCondition.hashCode() 和 AbstractRequestCondition.toString() 的实现。

items.source: A base class for RequestCondition types providing implementations of AbstractRequestCondition.equals(Object), AbstractRequestCondition.hashCode(), and AbstractRequestCondition.toString().
items.translation: 一个用于 `RequestCondition` 类型的基类，提供 `AbstractRequestCondition.equals(Object)`、`AbstractRequestCondition.hashCode()` 和 `AbstractRequestCondition.toString()` 的实现。

items.source: WebApplicationContext implementation which accepts component classes as input — in particular @Configuration classes, but also plain @Component classes as well as JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: WebApplicationContext实现接受组件类作为输入——特别是@Configuration类，但也包括普通的@Component类以及使用jakarta.inject注解的符合 JSR-330 规范的类。

items.source: Convenient subclass of Spring's standard MBeanExporter, activating annotation usage for JMX exposure of Spring beans: ManagedResource, ManagedAttribute, ManagedOperation, etc.
items.translation: Spring 标准 `MBeanExporter` 的便捷子类，用于激活注解以暴露 Spring Bean 到 JMX：`ManagedResource`、`ManagedAttribute`、`ManagedOperation` 等。

items.source: The default MessageHandlerMethodFactory implementation creating an InvocableHandlerMethod with the necessary HandlerMethodArgumentResolver instances to detect and process most of the use cases defined by MessageMapping.
items.translation: 默认 `MessageHandlerMethodFactory` 实现会创建一个 `InvocableHandlerMethod`，并包含必要的 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 实例，以检测和处理由 `MessageMapping` 定义的大多数用例。

items.source: Resource implementation for a given InputStream or a given InputStreamSource (which can be supplied as a lambda expression) for a lazy InputStream on demand.
items.translation: 为给定的InputStream或给定的InputStreamSource（可作为 lambda 表达式提供）创建Resource实现，以按需延迟加载InputStream。

items.source: Formatter implementation for a JSR-310 Instant, following JSR-310's parsing rules for an Instant (that is, not using a configurable DateTimeFormatter): accepting the default ISO_INSTANT format as well as RFC_1123_DATE_TIME (which is commonly used for HTTP date header values).
items.translation: `Formatter` 接口的实现，用于 JSR-310 的Instant，遵循 JSR-310 对 Instant 的解析规则（即不使用可配置的DateTimeFormatter）：接受默认的ISO_INSTANT格式以及RFC_1123_DATE_TIME（常用于 HTTP 日期标头值）。

items.source: Base class for Encoder, Decoder, HttpMessageReader, or HttpMessageWriter that uses a logger and shows potentially sensitive request data.
items.translation: `Encoder`、`Decoder`、`HttpMessageReader` 或 `HttpMessageWriter` 的基类，该类使用日志记录器并显示可能敏感的请求数据。

items.source: MergedContextConfiguration encapsulates the merged context configuration declared on a test class and all of its superclasses and enclosing classes via @ContextConfiguration, @ActiveProfiles, and @TestPropertySource.
items.translation: MergedContextConfiguration 封装了测试类及其所有父类和包含类上声明的 合并 上下文配置，这些配置通过 @ContextConfiguration、@ActiveProfiles 和 @TestPropertySource 指定。

items.source: Wrapper around MessageHeaders that provides extra features such as strongly typed accessors for specific headers, the ability to leave headers in a Message mutable, and the option to suppress automatic generation of id and timestamp headers.
items.translation: 围绕 `MessageHeaders` 的包装器，提供额外功能，例如针对特定标头的强类型访问器、使 `Message` 中的标头可变的选项，以及抑制自动生成 `id` 和 `timestamp` 标头的选项。

items.source: ReflectiveProcessor implementation for types annotated with @MessageMapping, @SubscribeMapping and @MessageExceptionHandler.
items.translation: ReflectiveProcessor 实现，用于处理带有 @MessageMapping、@SubscribeMapping 和 @MessageExceptionHandler 注解的类型。

items.source: NotificationPublisher implementation that uses the infrastructure provided by the ModelMBean interface to track javax.management.NotificationListeners and send Notifications to those listeners.
items.translation: NotificationPublisher 实现使用 ModelMBean 接口提供的基础设施来跟踪 javax.management.NotificationListeners 并向这些监听器发送 Notifications。

items.source: Resource implementation for Module resolution, performing ModuleResource.getInputStream() access via Module.getResourceAsStream(String).
items.translation: Resource 实现用于 Module 解析，通过 Module.getResourceAsStream(String) 执行 ModuleResource.getInputStream() 访问。

items.source: An extension of RequestMappingInfoHandlerMapping that creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations.
items.translation: 一个扩展了 `RequestMappingInfoHandlerMapping` 的类，它从类型级别和方法级别的 `@RequestMapping` 和 `@HttpExchange` 注解创建 `RequestMappingInfo` 实例。

items.source: Creates RequestMappingInfo instances from type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations in @Controller classes.
items.translation: 从 `@Controller` 类中的类型级和方法级@RequestMapping及@HttpExchange注解创建 RequestMappingInfo 实例。

items.source: Subclass of PropertiesPropertySource that loads a Properties object from a given Resource or resource location such as "classpath:/com/myco/foo.properties" or "file:/path/to/file.xml".
items.translation: 继承自PropertiesPropertySource的子类，用于从给定的Resource或资源位置（例如"classpath:/com/myco/foo.properties"或"file:/path/to/file.xml"）加载一个Properties对象。

items.source: Handler for return values of type ResponseEntity that delegates to one of the following: HttpEntityMethodProcessor for responses with a concrete body value ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler for responses with a body that is a ResponseBodyEmitter or an async/reactive type.
items.translation: 用于处理类型为 `ResponseEntity` 的返回值的处理器，它会委托给以下处理器之一： 对于具有具体体值的响应，委托给 `HttpEntityMethodProcessor`； 对于体为 `ResponseBodyEmitter` 或异步/响应式类型的响应，委托给 `ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler`。

items.source: Extension of TransactionalEventListenerFactory, detecting invalid transaction configuration for transactional event listeners: Transactional only supported with Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW and Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED.
items.translation: `TransactionalEventListenerFactory` 的扩展，用于检测事务性事件监听器的无效事务配置：仅支持使用 `Propagation.REQUIRES_NEW` 和 `Propagation.NOT_SUPPORTED` 的 `Transactional`。

items.source: The common implementation of Spring's SqlRowSet interface, wrapping a ResultSet, catching any SQLExceptions and translating them to a corresponding Spring InvalidResultSetAccessException.
items.translation: Spring 的 `SqlRowSet` 接口的通用实现封装了一个`ResultSet`,捕获任何 `SQLExceptions` 并将它们转换为相应的 Spring `InvalidResultSetAccessException`。

items.source: The default implementation of Spring's SqlRowSetMetaData interface, wrapping a ResultSetMetaData instance, catching any SQLExceptions and translating them to a corresponding Spring InvalidResultSetAccessException.
items.translation: Spring 的SqlRowSetMetaData接口的默认实现封装了一个ResultSetMetaData实例，捕获任何SQLExceptions并将其转换为相应的 Spring InvalidResultSetAccessException。

items.source: Central entry point to Spring's functional WebFlux framework. Exposes routing functionality, such as to create a RouterFunction using a discoverable builder-style API, to create a RouterFunction given a RequestPredicate and HandlerFunction, and to do further subrouting on an existing routing function.
items.translation: Spring 功能型 WebFlux 框架的中心入口点。提供路由功能，例如使用可发现的构建器风格 API 创建一个RouterFunction，在给定RequestPredicate和HandlerFunction时创建一个RouterFunction，以及对现有的路由函数进行进一步的子路由。

items.source: Main entry point to Spring's functional WebMvc framework. Exposes routing functionality, such as to create a RouterFunction using a discoverable builder-style API, to create a RouterFunction given a RequestPredicate and HandlerFunction, and to do further subrouting on an existing routing function.
items.translation: Spring 功能型 WebMvc 框架的主要入口点。提供路由功能，例如使用可发现的构建器风格 API 创建一个RouterFunction，在给定RequestPredicate和HandlerFunction时创建一个RouterFunction，以及对现有的路由函数进行进一步的子路由。

items.source: Extension of MessageMappingMessageHandler to handle RSocket requests with @MessageMapping and @ConnectMapping methods, also supporting use of @RSocketExchange.
items.translation: 扩展 `MessageMappingMessageHandler` 以处理带有 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@ConnectMapping` 方法的 RSocket 请求，同时也支持使用 `@RSocketExchange`。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that takes an interface which must have one or more methods with the signatures MyType xxx() or MyType xxx(MyIdType id) (typically, MyService getService() or MyService getService(String id)) and creates a dynamic proxy which implements that interface, delegating to an underlying BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它接收一个接口，该接口必须包含一个或多个签名为 `MyType xxx()` 或 `MyType xxx(MyIdType id)`（通常是 `MyService getService()` 或 `MyService getService(String id)`）的方法，并创建一个实现该接口的动态代理，将调用委托给底层的 `BeanFactory`。

items.source: A simple CacheResolver that resolves the Cache instance(s) based on a configurable CacheManager and the name of the cache(s) as provided by getCacheNames().
items.translation: 一个简单的CacheResolver，它根据可配置的CacheManager以及由getCacheNames()提供的缓存名称，解析Cache实例。

items.source: Strategy implementation for parsing Spring's Caching, Cacheable, CacheEvict, and CachePut annotations.
items.translation: 用于解析 Spring 的 `Caching`、`Cacheable`、`CacheEvict` 和 `CachePut` 注解的策略实现。

items.source: Cache decorator which synchronizes its TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.put(Object, Object), TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.evict(Object) and TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.clear() operations with Spring-managed transactions (through Spring's TransactionSynchronizationManager), performing the actual cache put/evict/clear operation only in the after-commit phase of a successful transaction.
items.translation: 同步其 TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.put(Object, Object)、TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.evict(Object) 和 TransactionAwareCacheDecorator.clear() 操作的缓存装饰器，这些操作与 Spring 管理的交易（通过 Spring 的 TransactionSynchronizationManager）同步，仅在成功交易的提交后阶段执行实际的缓存 put/evict/clear 操作。

items.source: Proxy for a target CacheManager, exposing transaction-aware Cache objects which synchronize their Cache.put(Object, Object) operations with Spring-managed transactions (through Spring's TransactionSynchronizationManager), performing the actual cache put operation only in the after-commit phase of a successful transaction.
items.translation: 目标 CacheManager 的代理，提供事务感知的 Cache 对象 其 Cache.put(Object, Object) 操作与 Spring 管理的事务同步（通过 Spring 的 TransactionSynchronizationManager）， 仅在成功事务的提交后阶段执行实际的缓存写入操作。

items.source: Mapping Function implementation that converts an R2DBC Readable (a Row or OutParameters) into a new instance of the specified mapped target class.
items.translation: 映射将 R2DBC Readable（即 Row 或 OutParameters）转换为指定映射目标类新实例的 Function 实现。

items.source: A ConcurrentHashMap variant that uses soft or weak references for both keys and values.
items.translation: 一个使用 `soft` 或 `weak` 引用作为 `keys` 和 `values` 的 `ConcurrentHashMap` 变体。

items.source: Mapping Function implementation that converts an R2DBC Readable (a Row or OutParameters) into a new instance of the specified mapped target class.
items.translation: 映射 `Function` 实现，用于将 R2DBC Readable（即 Row 或 OutParameters）转换为指定映射目标类的新实例。

items.source: Default implementation of the ActiveProfilesResolver strategy that resolves active bean definition profiles based solely on profiles configured declaratively via ActiveProfiles.profiles() or ActiveProfiles.value().
items.translation: `ActiveProfilesResolver` 策略的默认实现，该策略仅根据通过 ActiveProfiles.profiles() 或 ActiveProfiles.value() 以声明方式配置的配置文件，解析活动 Bean 定义配置文件。

items.source: Discovers @ExceptionHandler methods in a given class, including all of its superclasses, and helps to resolve a given Exception and MediaType requested by clients to combinations supported by a given Method.
items.translation: 在给定类（包括其所有父类）中查找带有 `@ExceptionHandler` 注解的方法，并帮助将客户端请求的特定 Exception 和 MediaType 解析为给定 Method 所支持的各种组合。

items.source: An ApplicationContext implementation that extends GenericApplicationContext and implements GroovyObject such that beans can be retrieved with the dot de-reference syntax instead of using AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String).
items.translation: 一个扩展了GenericApplicationContext并实现GroovyObject的ApplicationContext实现，使得可以通过点解引用语法获取 Bean，而无需使用AbstractApplicationContext.getBean(String)。

items.source: PersistenceExceptionTranslator capable of translating HibernateException and standard JPA PersistenceException instances to Spring' DataAccessException hierarchy.
items.translation: PersistenceExceptionTranslator 能够翻译 HibernateException和标准 JPA PersistenceException 实例到 Spring 的DataAccessException 层次结构。

items.source: A specialization of MessageSendingOperations, MessageReceivingOperations and MessageRequestReplyOperations for JMS related operations that allow to specify a destination name rather than the actual Destination.
items.translation: `MessageSendingOperations`、`MessageReceivingOperations` 和 `MessageRequestReplyOperations` 是 `MessageSendingOperations` 的特化版本，用于 JMS 相关操作，允许指定目标名称而非实际的 `Destination`。

items.source: Editor for MediaType descriptors, to automatically convert String specifications (for example, "text/html") to MediaType properties.
items.translation: Editor 用于 MediaType描述符，以自动将 String 规范（例如，"text/html"）转换为 MediaType 属性。

items.source: Convert a Message from the messaging abstraction to and from a Message using an underlying MessageConverter for the payload and a JmsHeaderMapper to map the JMS headers to and from standard message headers.
items.translation: 将消息抽象中的 `Message` 转换为使用底层 `MessageConverter` 处理负载的 `Message`，反之亦然，并使用 `JmsHeaderMapper` 将 JMS 标头与标准消息标头进行映射。

items.source: Mutable extension to Bindings for Value and null bindings for a Statement using BindMarkers.
items.translation: 用于使用BindMarkers为Statement绑定 Value 和null的Bindings的可变扩展。

items.source: RouteMatcher built on PathPatternParser that uses PathContainer and PathPattern as parsed representations of routes and patterns.
items.translation: 基于PathPatternParser构建的RouteMatcher，它使用PathContainer和PathPattern作为路由和模式的解析表示形式。

items.source: Extension of the Ordered interface, expressing a priority ordering: PriorityOrdered objects are always applied before plain Ordered objects regardless of their order values.
items.translation: 对 `Ordered` 接口的扩展，表达一种优先级排序：PriorityOrdered 对象始终在普通的Ordered对象之前应用，无论其顺序值如何。

items.source: Specialization of PlaceholderConfigurerSupport that resolves ${...} placeholders within bean definition property values and @Value annotations against the current Spring Environment and its set of PropertySources.
items.translation: `PlaceholderConfigurerSupport` 类的特化版本，用于解析 bean 定义属性值中的 ${...} 占位符以及 `@Value` 注解，依据当前的 Spring Environment 及其一组 PropertySources。

items.source: Resolves Map, MultiValueMap and HttpHeaders method arguments annotated with @RequestHeader.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestHeader` 注解的 `Map`、`MultiValueMap` 和 `HttpHeaders` 方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestParam, arguments of type MultipartFile in conjunction with Spring's MultipartResolver abstraction, and arguments of type jakarta.servlet.http.Part in conjunction with Servlet multipart requests.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestParam` 注解的方法参数，与 Spring 的 `MultipartResolver` 抽象配合使用的 `MultipartFile` 类型参数，以及与 Servlet 多部分请求配合使用的 `jakarta.servlet.http.Part` 类型参数。

items.source: Resolves the following method arguments: Annotated with @RequestPart Of type MultipartFile in conjunction with Spring's MultipartResolver abstraction Of type jakarta.servlet.http.Part in conjunction with Servlet multipart requests
items.translation: 解析以下方法参数： 带有 `@RequestPart` 注解 类型为 `MultipartFile`，结合 Spring 的 `MultipartResolver` 抽象 类型为 `jakarta.servlet.http.Part`，结合 Servlet 多部分请求

items.source: Filter that parses and caches a RequestPath that can then be accessed via ServletRequestPathUtils.getParsedRequestPath(ServletRequest).
items.translation: Filter 会解析并缓存一个 RequestPath，随后可通过 ServletRequestPathUtils.getParsedRequestPath(ServletRequest) 访问。

items.source: @SpringJUnitConfig is a composed annotation that combines @ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class) from JUnit Jupiter with @ContextConfiguration from the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: @SpringJUnitConfig 是一个 组合注解，它结合了来自 JUnit Jupiter 的@ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class)和来自 Spring TestContext Framework 的@ContextConfiguration。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing SQL scripts and inlined statements configured via the @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 提供对通过 `@Sql` 注解配置的 SQL scripts 和行内 statements 执行支持的TestExecutionListener。

items.source: HandlerAdapter that allows DispatcherHandler to support handlers of type WebSocketHandler with such handlers mapped to URL patterns via SimpleUrlHandlerMapping.
items.translation: 支持 `DispatcherHandler` 处理通过 `SimpleUrlHandlerMapping` 映射到 URL 模式的 `WebSocketHandler` 类型处理器的`HandlerAdapter`。

items.source: as of 6.2 along with LobHandler, in favor of ResultSet.getBinaryStream(int)/ResultSet.getCharacterStream(int) usage
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，连同LobHandler一起，转而推荐使用ResultSet.getBinaryStream(int)/ResultSet.getCharacterStream(int)用法。

items.source: Base implementation of ComponentDefinition that provides a basic implementation of AbstractComponentDefinition.getDescription() which delegates to ComponentDefinition.getName().
items.translation: `ComponentDefinition` 接口的基实现，提供了 `AbstractComponentDefinition.getDescription()` 方法的基本实现，该方法委托给 `ComponentDefinition.getName()`。

items.source: Base TypeReference implementation that ensures consistent behaviour for equals(), hashCode(), and toString() based on the canonical name.
items.translation: 基于TypeReference接口的基实现，确保根据规范名称对equals()、hashCode()和toString()的行为保持一致。

items.source: JobFactory implementation that supports Runnable objects as well as standard Quartz Job instances.
items.translation: JobFactory 实现，支持 Runnable对象以及标准的 Quartz Job 实例。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that registers AdvisorAdapter beans in the BeanFactory with an AdvisorAdapterRegistry (by default the GlobalAdvisorAdapterRegistry).
items.translation: 注册 `AdvisorAdapter` Bean 的 `BeanPostProcessor`，将其与 `AdvisorAdapterRegistry`（默认情况下为 `GlobalAdvisorAdapterRegistry`）一起注册到 BeanFactory 中。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume an AfterTestClassEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 AfterTestClassEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestClass(TestContext) 时。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume an AfterTestExecutionEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 AfterTestExecutionEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestExecution(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestExecution(TestContext) 时。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume an AfterTestMethodEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 AfterTestMethodEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.afterTestMethod(TestContext) 时。

items.source: Standalone application context, accepting component classes as input — in particular @Configuration-annotated classes, but also plain @Component types and JSR-330 compliant classes using jakarta.inject annotations.
items.translation: 独立应用程序上下文，接受组件类作为输入——特别是带有@Configuration注解的类，以及普通的@Component类型和符合 JSR-330 规范并使用`jakarta.inject`注解的类。

items.source: Implementation of the JCacheOperationSource interface that reads the JSR-107 CacheResult, CachePut, CacheRemove and CacheRemoveAll annotations.
items.translation: 实现 `JCacheOperationSource` 接口，用于读取 JSR-107 的 `CacheResult`、`CachePut`、`CacheRemove` 和 `CacheRemoveAll` 注解。

items.source: A collection of AOT services that can be loaded from a SpringFactoriesLoader or obtained from a ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 一组 AOT 服务，这些服务可以从loaded的SpringFactoriesLoader加载，或从ListableBeanFactory获取。

items.source: An implementation of DestinationResolver that interprets a destination name as the bean name of a MessageChannel and looks up the bean in the configured BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `DestinationResolver` 的类，它将目标名称解释为 `MessageChannel` 的 Bean 名称，并在配置的 `BeanFactory` 中查找该 Bean。

items.source: BeanRegistry implementation that delegates to BeanDefinitionRegistry and ListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanRegistry` 接口，该接口委托给 `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 和 `ListableBeanFactory`。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume a BeforeTestClassEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 BeforeTestClassEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestClass(TestContext) 时。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume a BeforeTestExecution published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 BeforeTestExecution 发布的 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestExecution(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestExecution(TestContext) 时。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume a BeforeTestMethodEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 BeforeTestMethodEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.beforeTestMethod(TestContext) 时。

items.source: Subclass of ConcurrentModel that automatically removes the BindingResult object when its corresponding target attribute is replaced through regular Map operations.
items.translation: `ConcurrentModel` 的子类，当通过常规的 Map 操作替换其对应的目标属性时，会自动移除 BindingResult 对象。

items.source: Subclass of ExtendedModelMap that automatically removes a BindingResult object if the corresponding target attribute gets replaced through regular Map operations.
items.translation: `ExtendedModelMap` 的子类，如果对应的目标属性通过常规的 Map 操作被替换，则会自动移除一个 BindingResult 对象。

items.source: Resolves a BindMarkersFactory from a ConnectionFactory using a BindMarkersFactoryResolver.BindMarkerFactoryProvider.
items.translation: 从ConnectionFactory使用BindMarkersFactoryResolver.BindMarkerFactoryProvider解析出BindMarkersFactory。

items.source: Caching implementation of the MetadataReaderFactory interface, caching a MetadataReader instance per Spring Resource handle (i.e.
items.translation: `MetadataReaderFactory` 接口的缓存实现，针对每个 Spring `Resource` 句柄缓存一个 `MetadataReader` 实例（即

items.source: CacheManager implementation that lazily builds CaffeineCache instances for each CaffeineCacheManager.getCache(String) request.
items.translation: CacheManager 实现，它会在每次请求 CaffeineCacheManager.getCache(String) 时懒加载构建 CaffeineCache 实例。

items.source: CacheManager implementation that lazily builds ConcurrentMapCache instances for each ConcurrentMapCacheManager.getCache(String) request.
items.translation: 实现CacheManager，为每个ConcurrentMapCacheManager.getCache(String)请求懒加载ConcurrentMapCache实例。

items.source: A GenericConverter that may conditionally execute based on attributes of the source and target TypeDescriptor.
items.translation: 一个可能根据 `source` 和 `target` TypeDescriptor的属性有条件执行的GenericConverter。

items.source: Specialization of ConfigurableEnvironment allowing initialization of servlet-related PropertySource objects at the earliest moment that the ServletContext and (optionally) ServletConfig become available.
items.translation: `ConfigurableEnvironment` 接口的特化版本，允许在 `ServletContext` 和（可选的）`ServletConfig` 最早可用时初始化与 servlet 相关的 `PropertySource` 对象。

items.source: Extended variant of BeanNameGenerator for @Configuration class purposes, not only covering bean name generation for component and configuration classes themselves but also for @Bean methods.
items.translation: `BeanNameGenerator` 接口的扩展变体，专为 `@Configuration` 类用途设计，不仅涵盖组件类和配置类本身的 Bean 名称生成，还包括 `@Bean` 方法。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a JSR-160 JMXConnectorServer, optionally registers it with the MBeanServer, and then starts it.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建 JSR-160 JMXConnectorServer， 可选地将其注册到 MBeanServer，然后启动它。

items.source: BeanDefinitionParser that parses a cors element in order to set the CORS configuration in the various {AbstractHandlerMapping} beans created by AnnotationDrivenBeanDefinitionParser, ResourcesBeanDefinitionParser and ViewControllerBeanDefinitionParser.
items.translation: BeanDefinitionParser 用于解析cors元素，以便在由AnnotationDrivenBeanDefinitionParser、ResourcesBeanDefinitionParser和ViewControllerBeanDefinitionParser创建的各个{AbstractHandlerMapping}bean中设置CORS配置。

items.source: Simple BeanFactoryPostProcessor implementation that registers custom Scope(s) with the containing ConfigurableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 简单的 `BeanFactoryPostProcessor` 实现，用于向包含的 `ConfigurableBeanFactory` 注册自定义的 `Scope(s)`。

items.source: DataSourceFactory encapsulates the creation of a particular DataSource implementation such as a non-pooling SimpleDriverDataSource or a HikariCP pool setup in the shape of a HikariDataSource.
items.translation: DataSourceFactory 封装了特定DataSource实现的创建，例如非池化SimpleDriverDataSource或配置为HikariDataSource的 HikariCP 连接池。

items.source: Default implementation of WebSessionManager delegating to a WebSessionIdResolver for session id resolution and to a WebSessionStore.
items.translation: `WebSessionManager` 接口的默认实现，委托给一个 `WebSessionIdResolver` 用于解析会话 ID，并委托给一个 `WebSessionStore`。

items.source: EntityResolver implementation that delegates to a BeansDtdResolver and a PluggableSchemaResolver for DTDs and XML schemas, respectively.
items.translation: EntityResolver 实现，该实现委托给 BeansDtdResolver 以及用于 DTD 和 XML 架构的 PluggableSchemaResolver。

items.source: A WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport extension that detects beans of type WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer and delegates to all of them allowing callback style customization of the configuration provided in WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport.
items.translation: 一个 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport` 扩展，用于检测类型为 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer` 的 Bean，并委托给所有这些 Bean，从而允许以回调方式自定义在 `WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurationSupport` 中提供的配置。

items.source: DisabledIfCondition is an ExecutionCondition that supports the @DisabledIf annotation when using the Spring TestContext Framework in conjunction with the JUnit Jupiter testing framework.
items.translation: DisabledIfCondition 是一个 ExecutionCondition，它在使用 Spring TestContext Framework 与 JUnit Jupiter 测试框架结合时，支持 @DisabledIf 注解。

items.source: ServletWebRequest subclass that is aware of DispatcherServlet's request context, such as the Locale determined by the configured LocaleResolver.
items.translation: `ServletWebRequest` 子类，能够感知 `DispatcherServlet` 的请求上下文，例如由配置的 `LocaleResolver` 确定的区域设置。

items.source: Declares that a field or method parameter should be formatted as a Duration, according to the specified Style and Unit.
items.translation: 声明字段或方法参数应按指定的Style和Unit格式化为Duration。

items.source: EnabledIfCondition is an ExecutionCondition that supports the @EnabledIf annotation when using the Spring TestContext Framework in conjunction with the JUnit Jupiter testing framework.
items.translation: EnabledIfCondition 是一个 ExecutionCondition，它支持在使用 Spring TestContext Framework 与 JUnit Jupiter 测试框架结合时，@EnabledIf 注解。

items.source: RuntimeException that implements ErrorResponse to expose an HTTP status, response headers, and a body formatted as an RFC 9457 ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 实现 ErrorResponse 的RuntimeException，用于暴露 HTTP 状态、响应头以及格式化为 RFC 9457ProblemDetail的正文。

items.source: Interceptor that publishes an ApplicationEvent to all ApplicationListeners registered with an ApplicationEventPublisher after each successful method invocation.
items.translation: Interceptor 会在每次成功的方法调用后，向所有已注册到 ApplicationEventPublisher 的 ApplicationListeners 发布一个 ApplicationEvent。

items.source: An extension of ChannelInterceptor with callbacks to intercept the asynchronous sending of a Message to a specific subscriber through an Executor.
items.translation: `ChannelInterceptor` 接口的扩展，带有回调以拦截通过 `Executor` 向特定订阅者异步发送 `Message` 的操作。

items.source: Implementation of ResponseErrorHandler that uses HttpMessageConverters to convert HTTP error responses to RestClientExceptions.
items.translation: 实现使用HttpMessageConverters将 HTTP 错误响应转换为RestClientExceptions的ResponseErrorHandler。

items.source: WebHandlerDecorator that invokes a chain of WebFilters before invoking the delegate WebHandler.
items.translation: WebHandlerDecorator 在调用委托 WebHandler 之前，会调用一系列 WebFilters。

items.source: Registers Converters and Formatters with a FormattingConversionService through the FormatterRegistry SPI.
items.translation: 通过 `FormatterRegistry` SPI 将 `Converters` 和 `Formatters` 注册到 `FormattingConversionService`。

items.source: Extended variant of FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator for @Configuration class purposes, not only enforcing fully-qualified names for component and configuration classes themselves but also fully-qualified default bean names ("className.methodName") for @Bean methods.
items.translation: `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 的扩展变体，专为 `@Configuration` 类用途设计，不仅强制组件类和配置类本身使用完全限定名称，还强制 `@Bean` 方法的默认 bean 名称（"className.methodName"）也使用完全限定名称。

items.source: Utility for building and configuring an immutable collection of HttpMessageConverter instances for client or server usage.
items.translation: 用于构建和配置不可变的HttpMessageConverter实例集合的工具，供client或server使用。

items.source: FactoryBean for HttpServiceProxyRegistry responsible for initializing HttpServiceGroups and creating the HTTP Service client proxies for each group.
items.translation: 负责初始化HttpServiceGroup并为每个组创建 HTTP 服务客户端代理的FactoryBean用于HttpServiceProxyRegistry。

items.source: Specialized Supplier that can be set on a BeanDefinition when details about the registered bean are needed to supply the instance.
items.translation: 专门用于在需要有关已注册 Bean的详细信息来提供实例时，可设置到BeanDefinition上的Supplier。

items.source: Allows for creating Jackson 3.x (ValueSerializer, ValueDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder, and TypeIdResolver) beans with autowiring against a Spring ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 允许创建 Jackson 3.x（`ValueSerializer`、`ValueDeserializer`、`KeyDeserializer`、`TypeResolverBuilder` 和 `TypeIdResolver`）bean，并支持从 Spring `ApplicationContext` 进行自动装配。

items.source: Simple implementation of MultiValueMap that wraps a LinkedHashMap, storing multiple values in an ArrayList.
items.translation: `MultiValueMap` 的简单实现，它包装了一个 `LinkedHashMap`，并在一个 `ArrayList` 中存储多个值。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the context's default LoadTimeWeaver to beans that implement the LoadTimeWeaverAware interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor实现，将上下文的默认 LoadTimeWeaver 传递给实现了 LoadTimeWeaverAware 接口的 Bean。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by @Configuration classes annotated with @EnableLoadTimeWeaving that wish to customize the LoadTimeWeaver instance to be used.
items.translation: 由带有 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving` 注解的、希望自定义要使用的 `LoadTimeWeaver` 实例的、实现 `@Configuration` 注解的类所实现的接口。

items.source: A Spring-provided extension of the standard Hibernate Configuration class, adding SpringSessionContext as a default and providing convenient ways to specify a JDBC DataSource and an application class loader.
items.translation: Spring 提供的标准 Hibernate Configuration 类的扩展，默认添加了 SpringSessionContext，并提供了便捷的方式来指定 JDBC DataSource 和应用类加载器。

items.source: Quartz ThreadPool adapter that delegates to a Spring-managed Executor instance, specified on SchedulerFactoryBean.
items.translation: Quartz 的ThreadPool适配器，该适配器委托给在SchedulerFactoryBean上指定的由 Spring 管理的 Executor实例。

items.source: This is the central class for jakarta.validation (JSR-303) setup in a Spring application context: It bootstraps a jakarta.validation.ValidationFactory and exposes it through the Spring Validator interface as well as through the JSR-303 Validator interface and the ValidatorFactory interface itself.
items.translation: 这是用于在 Spring 应用程序上下文中设置 `jakarta.validation` (JSR-303) 的中心类：它引导启动一个 `jakarta.validation.ValidationFactory`，并通过 Spring Validator 接口、JSR-303 `Validator` 接口以及 `ValidatorFactory` 接口本身将其暴露出来。

items.source: A simple log message type for use with Commons Logging, allowing for convenient lazy resolution of a given Supplier instance (typically bound to a lambda expression) or a printf-style format string (String.format(String, Object...)) in its LogMessage.toString().
items.translation: 一种简单的日志消息类型，可与 Commons Logging 配合使用，允许方便地在其 LogMessage.toString() 中惰性解析给定的 Supplier 实例（通常绑定为 lambda 表达式）或 printf 风格的格式字符串 (String.format(String, Object...))。

items.source: Implementation of HttpMessageConverter that can read and write XML using Spring's Marshaller and Unmarshaller abstractions.
items.translation: 实现能够使用 Spring 的Marshaller和Unmarshaller抽象来读写 XML 的HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Spring JMS MessageConverter that uses a Marshaller and Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 使用 `Marshaller` 和 `Unmarshaller` 的 Spring JMS MessageConverter。

items.source: Implementation of MessageConverter that can read and write XML using Spring's Marshaller and Unmarshaller abstractions.
items.translation: 实现能够使用 Spring 的Marshaller和Unmarshaller抽象来读写 XML 的MessageConverter。

items.source: FactoryBean that obtains a MBeanServer reference through the standard JMX 1.2 MBeanServerFactory API.
items.translation: FactoryBean 通过标准 JMX 1.2 MBeanServerFactory API 获取 MBeanServer 引用。

items.source: A builder for creating a GenericMessage (or ErrorMessage if the payload is of type Throwable).
items.translation: 用于创建GenericMessage（如果负载类型为Throwable，则为ErrorMessage）的构建器。

items.source: Extension of the Runnable interface with methods to obtain the MessageHandler and Message to be handled.
items.translation: 扩展 `Runnable` 接口，添加用于获取待处理的 `MessageHandler` 和 `Message` 的方法。

items.source: MethodValidator that uses a Bean Validation Validator for validation, and adapts ConstraintViolations to MethodValidationResult.
items.translation: MethodValidator 使用 Bean Validation Validator 进行验证，并将 ConstraintViolations 适配为 MethodValidationResult。

items.source: Simple ConfigurableEnvironment implementation exposing MockEnvironment.setProperty(String, Object) and MockEnvironment.withProperty(String, Object) methods for testing purposes.
items.translation: 简单的 `ConfigurableEnvironment` 实现，暴露了用于测试目的的 `MockEnvironment.setProperty(String, Object)` 和 `MockEnvironment.withProperty(String, Object)` 方法。

items.source: Extension of DefaultServerWebExchange for use in tests, along with MockServerHttpRequest and MockServerHttpResponse.
items.translation: 用于测试的 `DefaultServerWebExchange` 扩展，以及 MockServerHttpRequest 和 MockServerHttpResponse。

items.source: A basic, no operation ResponseErrorHandler implementation suitable for ignoring any error using the RestTemplate or RestClient.
items.translation: 一个基本的、不执行任何操作的ResponseErrorHandler实现，适用于忽略使用RestTemplate或RestClient时的任何错误。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that returns a value which is an ObjectFactory that in turn returns a bean sourced from a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它返回一个值为 `ObjectFactory` 的对象，该对象进而从一个 `BeanFactory` 获取一个 bean。

items.source: Structured representation of a URI path parsed via PathContainer.parsePath(String) into a sequence of PathContainer.Separator and PathContainer.PathSegment elements.
items.translation: 通过 `PathContainer.parsePath(String)` 解析的 URI 路径的结构化表示，转换为一系列 `PathContainer.Separator` 和 `PathContainer.PathSegment` 元素。

items.source: A resolver to extract and decode the payload of a message using a Decoder, where the payload is expected to be a Publisher of DataBuffer.
items.translation: 一个解析器，用于使用Decoder提取并解码消息的负载，其中负载预期为Publisher类型的DataBuffer。

items.source: @EventListener annotation used to consume a PrepareTestInstanceEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @EventListener 注解用于消费由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 PrepareTestInstanceEvent。

items.source: TestContextEvent published by the EventPublishingTestExecutionListener when TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext) is invoked.
items.translation: 由 EventPublishingTestExecutionListener 发布的 TestContextEvent，当调用 TestExecutionListener.prepareTestInstance(TestContext) 时。

items.source: Describes the semantics of a reactive type including boolean checks for ReactiveTypeDescriptor.isMultiValue(), ReactiveTypeDescriptor.isNoValue(), and ReactiveTypeDescriptor.supportsEmpty().
items.translation: 描述反应式类型的语义，包括对 `ReactiveTypeDescriptor.isMultiValue()`、`ReactiveTypeDescriptor.isNoValue()` 和 `ReactiveTypeDescriptor.supportsEmpty()` 的布尔检查。

items.source: A ModelMap implementation of RedirectAttributes that formats values as Strings using a DataBinder.
items.translation: 一个实现了RedirectAttributes的ModelMap，它使用DataBinder将值格式化为字符串。

items.source: Extension of AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter that supports @RequestMapping annotated HandlerMethods.
items.translation: 扩展了支持带有 `@RequestMapping` 注解的 `HandlerMethods` 的 `AbstractHandlerMethodAdapter`。

items.source: Specialization of PathContainer that subdivides the path into a RequestPath.contextPath() and the remaining RequestPath.pathWithinApplication().
items.translation: `PathContainer` 接口的特化版本，它将路径细分为 `RequestPath.contextPath()` 和剩余的 `RequestPath.pathWithinApplication()`。

items.source: Extension point for applications or 3rd party libraries that wish to further initialize a MockHttpServletRequest instance after it has been built by MockHttpServletRequestBuilder or its subclass MockMultipartHttpServletRequestBuilder.
items.translation: 供应用程序或第三方库使用的扩展点，以便在 MockHttpServletRequest 实例由 MockHttpServletRequestBuilder 或其子类 MockMultipartHttpServletRequestBuilder 构建后进行进一步初始化。

items.source: An extension of ByteArrayOutputStream that: has public ResizableByteArrayOutputStream.grow(int) and ResizableByteArrayOutputStream.resize(int) methods to get more control over the size of the internal buffer has a higher initial capacity (256) by default
items.translation: 这是一个扩展了 ByteArrayOutputStream 的类，其特点如下： * 提供公共的 ResizableByteArrayOutputStream.grow(int) 和 ResizableByteArrayOutputStream.resize(int) 方法，以便更灵活地控制内部缓冲区的大小。 * 默认具有更高的初始容量（256）。

items.source: Editor for Resource arrays, to automatically convert String location patterns (for example, "file:C:/my*.txt" or "classpath*:myfile.txt") to Resource array properties.
items.translation: 用于 `Resource` 数组的编辑器，可自动将 `String` 位置模式（例如，`"file:C:/my*.txt"` 或 `"classpath*:myfile.txt"`）转换为 `Resource` 数组属性。

items.source: PropertyEditorRegistrar implementation that populates a given PropertyEditorRegistry (typically a BeanWrapper used for bean creation within an ApplicationContext) with resource editors.
items.translation: 实现 `PropertyEditorRegistrar` 接口以填充给定的 `PropertyEditorRegistry`（通常是用于在 `ApplicationContext` 中创建 Bean 的 `BeanWrapper`）的资源编辑器。

items.source: TransactionSynchronization implementation that manages a ResourceHolder bound through TransactionSynchronizationManager.
items.translation: TransactionSynchronization 实现，用于管理通过 TransactionSynchronizationManager 绑定的 ResourceHolder。

items.source: HttpMessageReader that wraps and delegates to a ResourceDecoder that extracts the filename from the "Content-Disposition" header, if available, and passes it as the ResourceDecoder.FILENAME_HINT.
items.translation: HttpMessageReader 包装并委托给一个 ResourceDecoder，该解码器如果可用，则从 "Content-Disposition" 头中提取文件名，并将其作为 ResourceDecoder.FILENAME_HINT 传递。

items.source: Region of a Resource implementation, materialized by a position within the Resource and a byte count for the length of that region.
items.translation: Resource 实现区域的起始位置，由 Resource 内的 position 和表示该区域长度的字节数 count 确定。

items.source: Implementation of HttpMessageConverter that can write a single ResourceRegion or Collections of ResourceRegions.
items.translation: 实现能够写入单个ResourceRegion或ResourceRegions集合的HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: HttpExchangeAdapter that enables an HttpServiceProxyFactory to use RestClient for request execution.
items.translation: HttpExchangeAdapter 使 HttpServiceProxyFactory 能够使用 RestClient 执行请求。

items.source: HttpExchangeAdapter that enables an HttpServiceProxyFactory to use RestTemplate for request execution.
items.translation: HttpExchangeAdapter 使 HttpServiceProxyFactory 能够使用 RestTemplate 执行请求。

items.source: A basic implementation of RetryOperations that executes and potentially retries a Retryable operation based on a configured RetryPolicy.
items.translation: 一个基本的RetryOperations实现，它根据配置的RetryPolicy执行并可能重试一个Retryable操作。

items.source: An interface used by JdbcTemplate and NamedParameterJdbcTemplate for processing rows of a ResultSet on a per-row basis.
items.translation: 由 `JdbcTemplate` 和 `NamedParameterJdbcTemplate` 使用的接口，用于逐行处理 `ResultSet` 的行。

items.source: Extension of AbstractEncoderMethodReturnValueHandler that handles encoded content by wrapping data buffers as RSocket payloads and by passing those through the RSocketPayloadReturnValueHandler.RESPONSE_HEADER header.
items.translation: `AbstractEncoderMethodReturnValueHandler` 的扩展，handles 编码内容，通过将数据缓冲区包装为 RSocket 负载并传递这些负载通过 RSocketPayloadReturnValueHandler.RESPONSE_HEADER 头。

items.source: FactoryBean that sets up a ScheduledExecutorService (by default: a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor) and exposes it for bean references.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于设置一个 ScheduledExecutorService（默认值：一个 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor），并将其暴露以供 bean 引用。

items.source: A HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler for sending to destinations specified in a SendTo or SendToUser method-level annotations.
items.translation: 用于向在 `SendTo` 或 `SendToUser` 方法级注解中指定的目的地发送消息的 `HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler`。

items.source: Reader that supports a stream of ServerSentEvents and also plain Objects which is the same as an ServerSentEvent with data only.
items.translation: 支持 `ServerSentEvents` 流以及普通 Objects（等同于仅包含数据的 ServerSentEvent）的阅读器。

items.source: A Servlet-specific AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter that creates a NativeWebRequest from ServletRequestAttributes.
items.translation: 一个 Servlet 专用的AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter，它从ServletRequestAttributes创建NativeWebRequest。

items.source: Delegate for creating shareable Session/StatelessSession references for a given SessionFactory.
items.translation: 用于为给定SessionFactory创建可共享的Session/StatelessSession引用的委托。

items.source: HandlerAdapter that allows using the plain WebHandler contract with the generic DispatcherHandler.
items.translation: 允许使用普通的WebHandler契约与通用的DispatcherHandler配合使用的HandlerAdapter。

items.source: A Supplier decorator that caches a singleton result and makes it available from SingletonSupplier.get() (nullable) and SingletonSupplier.obtain() (null-safe).
items.translation: 一个 `Supplier` 装饰器，用于缓存单个结果，并通过 SingletonSupplier.get()（可为 null）和 SingletonSupplier.obtain()（非空安全）提供该结果。

items.source: A specialization of HttpMessageConverter that can convert an HTTP request into a target object of a specified ResolvableType and a source object of a specified ResolvableType into an HTTP response with optional hints.
items.translation: 一种 `HttpMessageConverter` 的特化实现，可将 HTTP 请求转换为指定 ResolvableType 的目标对象，并将指定 ResolvableType 的源对象转换为带有可选提示的 HTTP 响应。

items.source: Extended variant of a RequestBuilder that applies its org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessors as a separate step from the RequestBuilder.buildRequest(ServletContext) method.
items.translation: `RequestBuilder` 接口的扩展变体，它将 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessors` 作为与 `RequestBuilder.buildRequest(ServletContext)` 方法分开的独立步骤进行应用。

items.source: Extension of the RequiredModelMBean class that ensures the thread context ClassLoader is switched for the managed resource's ClassLoader before any invocations occur.
items.translation: 扩展 `RequiredModelMBean` 类，确保在发生任何调用之前，将 `thread context ClassLoader` 切换为受管资源的 `ClassLoader`。

items.source: Common SqlValue implementation for JDBC Array creation based on the JDBC 4 Connection.createArrayOf(String, Object[]) method.
items.translation: 用于基于 JDBC 4 Connection.createArrayOf(String, Object[]) 方法创建 JDBC Array 的常用SqlValue实现。

items.source: ResultSetExtractor implementation that returns a Spring SqlRowSet representation for each given ResultSet.
items.translation: ResultSetExtractor 实现，为每个给定的 ResultSet 返回一个 Spring SqlRowSet表示。

items.source: A basic TypeComparator implementation: supports comparison of Number types as well as types implementing Comparable.
items.translation: 一个基本的TypeComparator实现：支持比较Number类型以及实现Comparable的类型。

items.source: A simple implementation of TypeLocator that uses the default ClassLoader or a supplied ClassLoader to locate types.
items.translation: 一个简单实现 TypeLocator 的类，它使用默认的ClassLoader或提供的ClassLoader来定位类型。

items.source: TcpMessageCodec for STOMP, delegating to StompDecoder and StompEncoder.
items.translation: 用于 STOMP 的 TcpMessageCodec，委托给 StompDecoder 和 StompEncoder。

items.source: An implementation of WebSocketHandler that delegates incoming WebSocket messages to a SubProtocolHandler along with a MessageChannel to which the sub-protocol handler can send messages from WebSocket clients to the application.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `WebSocketHandler` 的类，它将传入的 WebSocket 消息委托给一个 `SubProtocolHandler`，并附带一个 `MessageChannel`，子协议处理程序可以通过该通道将来自 WebSocket 客户端的消息发送到应用程序。

items.source: Extension of HandlerMethod that invokes the underlying method via InvocableHandlerMethod but uses sync argument resolvers only and thus can return directly a HandlerResult with no async wrappers.
items.translation: 扩展了HandlerMethod，它通过InvocableHandlerMethod调用底层方法，但仅使用同步参数解析器，因此可以直接返回一个HandlerResult，无需异步包装。

items.source: Parser implementation for a JSR-310 TemporalAccessor, using a DateTimeFormatter (the contextual one, if available).
items.translation: Parser 实现用于 JSR-310 TemporalAccessor，使用 DateTimeFormatter（如果可用，则使用上下文相关的）。

items.source: Printer implementation for a JSR-310 TemporalAccessor, using a DateTimeFormatter) (the contextual one, if available).
items.translation: `Printer` 接口的 JSR-310 TemporalAccessor 实现，使用 DateTimeFormatter（如果可用则使用上下文中的那个）。

items.source: GenerationContext test implementation that uses InMemoryGeneratedFiles and can configure a TestCompiler instance.
items.translation: GenerationContext 测试实现，使用 InMemoryGeneratedFiles 并可配置 TestCompiler 实例。

items.source: An HttpServiceArgumentResolver that uses the provided UriBuilderFactory to expand the UriTemplate.
items.translation: 一个使用提供的UriBuilderFactory来扩展UriTemplate的HttpServiceArgumentResolver。

items.source: Representation of a URI template that can be expanded with URI variables via UriTemplate.expand(Map) or UriTemplate.expand(Object[]), or matched to a URL via UriTemplate.match(String).
items.translation: 表示一个 URI 模板，该模板可以通过 UriTemplate.expand(Map) 或 UriTemplate.expand(Object[]) 使用 URI 变量进行扩展，或者通过 UriTemplate.match(String) 与 URL 匹配。

items.source: ReactorHttpExchangeAdapter that enables an HttpServiceProxyFactory to use WebClient for request execution.
items.translation: ReactorHttpExchangeAdapter 使 HttpServiceProxyFactory 能够使用 WebClient 执行请求。

items.source: WebSocket connection manager that connects to the server via WebSocketClient and handles the session with a WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: 通过 `WebSocketClient` 连接到服务器，并使用 `WebSocketHandler` 处理会话的 WebSocket connection manager。

items.source: as of 5.2, to be removed in 8.0; use org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer instead which is more flexible through taking advantage of the Environment and PropertySource mechanisms.
items.translation: 自 5.2 版本起，将在 8.0 版本中移除；请使用 org.springframework.context.support.PropertySourcesPlaceholderConfigurer 替代，它通过利用Environment和PropertySource机制，提供了更高的灵活性。

items.source: Base implementation of DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer that delegates to a single AbstractDataFieldMaxValueIncrementer.getNextKey() template method that returns a long.
items.translation: `DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer` 接口的基实现，委托给单个 `AbstractDataFieldMaxValueIncrementer.getNextKey()` 模板方法，该方法返回一个 `long`。

items.source: Abstract base class for TestExecutionListener implementations that provide support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: 用于提供支持的 `` 实现的抽象基类，该支持包括将带有 @DirtiesContext 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 ApplicationContext 标记为 dirty。

items.source: A convenient base class for ResponseBodyAdvice implementations that customize the response before JSON serialization with AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter's and AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter's concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 一个方便的基类，用于实现 ResponseBodyAdvice 以在 JSON 序列化之前自定义响应，适用于使用AbstractJacksonHttpMessageConverter和AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter具体子类的场景。

items.source: Abstract base class for MessageSource implementations based on resource bundle conventions, such as ResourceBundleMessageSource and ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource.
items.translation: 基于资源包约定（如ResourceBundleMessageSource和ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource）的`MessageSource`实现抽象基类。

items.source: Abstract ConnectionFactory implementation that routes AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory.create() calls to one of various target factories based on a lookup key.
items.translation: 实现抽象 ConnectionFactory，根据查找键将 AbstractRoutingConnectionFactory.create() 调用路由到各种目标 工厂 之一。

items.source: Access visibility types as determined by the modifiers on a Member or ResolvableType.
items.translation: 通过 `modifiers` 确定的访问可见性类型，应用于 `Member` 或 `ResolvableType`。

items.source: Convenient base class for ImportSelector implementations that select imports based on an AdviceMode value from an annotation (such as the @Enable* annotations).
items.translation: 用于基于注解（例如 `@Enable*` 注解）中的 `AdviceMode` 值来选择导入的 `ImportSelector` 实现的便捷基类。

items.source: Specialization of AsyncExecutionInterceptor that delegates method execution to an Executor based on the Async annotation.
items.translation: `AsyncExecutionInterceptor` 类的特化版本，该委托方法执行到基于 `Async` 注解的 `Executor`。

items.source: BeanNameGenerator implementation for bean classes annotated with the @Component annotation or with another annotation that is itself annotated with @Component as a meta-annotation.
items.translation: 为带有 `@Component` 注解的 bean 类，或带有另一个本身以 `@Component` 作为元注解进行标注的注解的 bean 类提供 `BeanNameGenerator` 实现。

items.source: AspectJPointcutAdvisor adapts an AbstractAspectJAdvice to the PointcutAdvisor interface.
items.translation: AspectJPointcutAdvisor 将 AbstractAspectJAdvice 适配到 PointcutAdvisor 接口。

items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractAsyncConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableAsync.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类上 EnableAsync.mode() 的值，选择应使用的 AbstractAsyncConfiguration 实现。

items.source: Interface to be implemented for customizing the Executor instance used when processing async method invocations or the AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler instance used to process exceptions thrown from async methods with a void return type.
items.translation: 用于自定义处理异步方法调用时使用的Executor实例，或用于处理从返回类型为void的异步方法中抛出的异常时使用的AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler实例的接口。

items.source: Registers an auto proxy creator against the current BeanDefinitionRegistry as appropriate based on an @Enable* annotation having mode and proxyTargetClass attributes set to the correct values.
items.translation: 根据当前BeanDefinitionRegistry注册自动代理创建器，前提是@Enable*注解的mode和proxyTargetClass属性已设置为正确的值。

items.source: Subclass of BeanDefinitionStoreException indicating an invalid override attempt: typically registering a new definition for the same bean name while DefaultListableBeanFactory.isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding() is false.
items.translation: `BeanDefinitionStoreException` 的子类，表示无效的覆盖尝试：通常是在注册与同一 bean 名称对应的新定义时，而 `DefaultListableBeanFactory.isAllowBeanDefinitionOverriding()` 为 `false`。

items.source: Value object representing value and null bindings for a Statement using BindMarkers.
items.translation: 表示使用BindMarkers为Statement绑定值和null的 Value 对象。

items.source: A CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate is responsible for loading and closing application contexts, interacting transparently with a ContextCache behind the scenes.
items.translation: `CacheAwareContextLoaderDelegate` 负责加载和关闭应用程序上下文，并在幕后与 `ContextCache` 接口进行透明交互。

items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractCachingConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableCaching.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 `@Configuration` 类上 EnableCaching.mode() 的值，选择应使用的 AbstractCachingConfiguration 实现。

items.source: SingleConnectionFactory subclass that adds Session caching as well as MessageProducer and MessageConsumer caching.
items.translation: SingleConnectionFactory 子类，增加了 Session、MessageProducer 和 MessageConsumer 的缓存功能。

items.source: HttpServletRequest wrapper that caches all content read from the input stream and reader, and allows this content to be retrieved via a byte array.
items.translation: HttpServletRequest 包装器，缓存从 输入流 和 读取器 读取的所有内容，并允许通过 字节数组 检索此内容。

items.source: Complete implementation of the AutowireCandidateResolver strategy interface, providing support for qualifier annotations as well as for lazy resolution driven by the Lazy annotation in the context.annotation package.
items.translation: 完整实现`AutowireCandidateResolver`策略接口，提供对限定符注解以及由`context.annotation`包中的Lazy注解驱动的懒加载的支持。

items.source: Filter to handle CORS pre-flight requests and intercept CORS simple and actual requests with a CorsProcessor, and to update the response, for example, with CORS response headers, based on the policy matched through the provided CorsConfigurationSource.
items.translation: Filter 用于处理 CORS 预检请求，并通过 CorsProcessor 拦截 CORS 简单和实际请求，同时根据通过提供的 CorsConfigurationSource 匹配的策略更新响应（例如，添加 CORS 响应头）。

items.source: @DisabledIf is used to signal that the annotated test class or test method is disabled and should not be executed if the supplied DisabledIf.expression() evaluates to true.
items.translation: @DisabledIf 用于标记被注释的测试类或测试方法处于 禁用 状态，如果提供的DisabledIf.expression() 评估结果为 true，则不应执行该方法。

items.source: Formatter implementation for a JSR-310 Duration, following JSR-310's parsing rules for a Duration by default and supporting additional DurationFormat.Style styles.
items.translation: `Formatter` 接口的实现，用于 JSR-310 的Duration，默认遵循 JSR-310 的 Duration 解析规则，并支持额外的DurationFormat.Style样式。

items.source: @EnabledIf is used to signal that the annotated test class or test method is enabled and should be executed if the supplied EnabledIf.expression() evaluates to true.
items.translation: @EnabledIf 用于指示被注解的测试类或测试方法处于“启用”状态，如果提供的EnabledIf.expression()求值为 true，则应执行该方法。

items.source: Resolves method arguments of type HttpEntity or RequestEntity by reading the body of the request through a compatible HttpMessageReader.
items.translation: 解析类型为HttpEntity或RequestEntity的方法参数，通过兼容的HttpMessageReader读取请求正文。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any @Configuration class that wishes to be injected with the AnnotationMetadata of the @Configuration class that imported it.
items.translation: 任何希望被注入导入它的@Configuration类的AnnotationMetadata的@Configuration类必须实现的接口。

items.source: Production implementation of the JavaMailSender interface, supporting both JavaMail MimeMessages and Spring SimpleMailMessages.
items.translation: 生产环境实现 `JavaMailSender` 接口，支持 JavaMail 的 `MimeMessages` 和 Spring 的 `SimpleMailMessages`。

items.source: FactoryBean for a JCache javax.cache.CacheManager, obtaining a pre-defined CacheManager by name through the standard JCache javax.cache.Caching class.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于 JCache javax.cache.CacheManager，通过标准的 JCache javax.cache.Caching 类按名称获取预定义的 CacheManager。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers a JmsListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor bean capable of processing Spring's @JmsListener annotation.
items.translation: @Configuration 类注册了一个 JmsListenerAnnotationBeanPostProcessor Bean，该 Bean 能够处理 Spring 的 @JmsListener 注解。

items.source: A RequestBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for Jackson's @JsonView annotation declared on a Spring MVC @HttpEntity or @RequestBody method parameter.
items.translation: 一个实现了RequestBodyAdvice的类，它为在 Spring MVC 的@HttpEntity或@RequestBody方法参数上声明的 Jackson@JsonView注解提供支持。

items.source: A ResponseBodyAdvice implementation that adds support for Jackson's @JsonView annotation declared on a Spring MVC @RequestMapping or @ExceptionHandler method.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `ResponseBodyAdvice` 的类，它为在 Spring MVC `@RequestMapping` 或 `@ExceptionHandler` 方法上声明的 Jackson `@JsonView` 注解提供支持。

items.source: Adapt LocaleContextHolder to the ThreadLocalAccessor contract to assist the Micrometer Context Propagation library with LocaleContext propagation.
items.translation: 适配LocaleContextHolder以符合ThreadLocalAccessor契约，从而协助 Micrometer 上下文传播库进行LocaleContext传播。

items.source: Source implementation that uses a Marshaller.Can be constructed with a Marshaller and an object to be marshalled.
items.translation: Source 实现，它使用 Marshaller。可以通过 Marshaller 和要序列化的对象来构造。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates a JMX 1.2 MBeanServerConnection to a remote MBeanServer exposed via a JMXServerConnector.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建 JMX 1.2 MBeanServerConnection，以连接到通过 JMXServerConnector 暴露的远程 MBeanServer。

items.source: Implementation of Hibernate Validator 4.3/5.x's ResourceBundleLocator interface, exposing a Spring MessageSource as localized MessageSourceResourceBundle.
items.translation: 实现 Hibernate Validator 4.3/5.x 的 `ResourceBundleLocator` 接口，将 Spring MessageSource 暴露为本地化的 MessageSourceResourceBundle。

items.source: A common key class for a method against a specific target class, including MethodClassKey.toString() representation and Comparable support (as suggested for custom HashMap keys as of Java 8).
items.translation: 针对特定目标类的方法的通用键类，包括 `MethodClassKey.toString()` 表示形式以及 `Comparable` 支持（如 Java 8 中针对自定义 `HashMap` 键所建议的那样）。

items.source: MockMvcWebConnection enables MockMvc to transform a WebRequest into a WebResponse.
items.translation: MockMvcWebConnection 使 MockMvc 能够将一个 WebRequest 转换为 WebResponse。

items.source: Specification for configuring MockMvc to test one or more router functions directly, and a simple facade around RouterFunctionMockMvcBuilder.
items.translation: 配置MockMvc以直接测试一个或多个路由函数的规范，以及围绕RouterFunctionMockMvcBuilder的简单封装。

items.source: Base class for Netty-based WebSocketSession adapters that provides convenience methods to convert Netty WebSocketFrames to and from WebSocketMessages.
items.translation: 基于 Netty 的 `WebSocketSession` 适配器基类，提供将 Netty WebSocketFrames 转换为和从 WebSocketMessages 转换的便捷方法。

items.source: An HttpMessageConverter that uses StringHttpMessageConverter for reading and writing content and a ConversionService for converting the String content to and from the target object type.
items.translation: 一个使用StringHttpMessageConverter来读取和写入内容，并使用ConversionService将 String 内容与目标对象类型之间进行转换的HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Result handler that prints MvcResult details to a given output stream — for example: System.out, System.err, a custom java.io.PrintWriter, etc.
items.translation: 用于将 `MvcResult` 详细信息打印到指定输出流（例如：System.out、System.err、自定义 java.io.PrintWriter 等）的结果处理器。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that returns a value which is a JSR-330 Provider that in turn returns a bean sourced from a BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它返回一个 JSR-330 `Provider` 值，该值进而返回源自 `BeanFactory` 的 bean。

items.source: @RecordApplicationEvents is an annotation that can be applied to a test class to instruct the Spring TestContext Framework to record all application events that are published in the ApplicationContext during the execution of a single test, either from the test thread or its descendants.
items.translation: @RecordApplicationEvents 是一个注解，可应用于测试类，以指示 Spring TestContext Framework 记录在单个测试执行期间发布的、来自测试线程或其子线程的 application events，这些事件是在 ApplicationContext 中发布的。

items.source: Builder for an AOT contribution that detects the presence of @Reflective on annotated elements and invoke the underlying ReflectiveProcessor implementations.
items.translation: 用于构建 AOT 贡献的BeanFactoryInitializationAotContribution，该贡献会检测已标注元素上是否存在 @Reflective 并调用底层的 ReflectiveProcessor 实现。

items.source: Adapt RequestContextHolder to the ThreadLocalAccessor contract to assist the Micrometer Context Propagation library with RequestAttributes propagation.
items.translation: 适配 RequestContextHolder 以符合 ThreadLocalAccessor 契约，从而协助 Micrometer Context Propagation 库进行 RequestAttributes 传播。

items.source: Subclass of ErrorResponseException that accepts a "reason", and by default maps that to the "detail" of the ProblemDetail.
items.translation: 继承自ErrorResponseException的子类，它接受一个 "reason" 参数，并默认将其映射到ProblemDetail的"detail"。

items.source: A shortcut annotation that combines @ControllerAdvice with @ResponseBody, in effect simply an @ControllerAdvice whose exception handler methods render to the response body.
items.translation: 一个快捷注解，结合了 @ControllerAdvice 与 @ResponseBody，实际上就是一个异常处理程序方法会渲染到响应体的@ControllerAdvice。

items.source: AssertProvider for RestTestClientResponseAssert that holds the result of an exchange performed through RestTestClient.
items.translation: AssertProvider 用于 RestTestClientResponseAssert，其中保存了通过 RestTestClient 执行的交换操作的结果。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers a ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor bean capable of processing Spring's @Scheduled annotation.
items.translation: `@Configuration` 类注册了一个 `ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` Bean，该 Bean 能够处理 Spring 的 `@Scheduled` 注解。

items.source: Inserts an attribute in the Reactor Context that makes the current ServerWebExchange available under the attribute name ServerWebExchangeContextFilter.EXCHANGE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE.
items.translation: 在 Reactor Context 中插入一个属性，使当前的 ServerWebExchange 可在属性名称 ServerWebExchangeContextFilter.EXCHANGE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE 下可用。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes all services for the configured service class, represented as a List of service objects, obtained through the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露了配置的服务类的所有服务，表示为通过 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader 设施获取的服务对象列表。

items.source: Extends InvocableHandlerMethod with the ability to handle return values through a registered HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler and also supports setting the response status based on a method-level @ResponseStatus annotation.
items.translation: 扩展InvocableHandlerMethod，使其能够通过注册的HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler处理返回值，并且支持根据方法级别的@ResponseStatus注解设置响应状态。

items.source: A simple DestinationResolver implementation for Session-based destination resolution, caching Queue and Topic instances per queue/topic name.
items.translation: 一个简单的针对基于 `Session` 的目标解析的DestinationResolver实现，按队列/主题名称缓存Queue和Topic实例。
