items.translation: 用于为处理器方法的映射分配名称的策略。

items.source:
Strategy interface to handle the value returned from the invocation of a
handler method.
items.translation: 用于处理从处理器方法调用中返回值的策略接口。

items.source: Represent the result of the invocation of a handler or a handler method.
items.translation: 表示调用处理器或处理器方法的结果。

items.source:
AssertJ assertions that can be applied
to a handler or handler method.
items.translation: 可应用于处理器或处理器方法的 AssertJ 断言。

items.source:
Thrown when handshake processing failed to complete due to an internal, unrecoverable
error.
items.translation: 当握手处理因内部不可恢复的错误而无法完成时抛出。

items.source: Contract for processing a WebSocket handshake request.
items.translation: 用于处理 WebSocket 握手请求的合约。

items.source: Interceptor for WebSocket handshake requests.
items.translation: WebSocket 握手请求的拦截器。

items.source: Resolver that looks at the 'Accept' header of the request.
items.translation: 解析器会查看请求的 'Accept' 标头。

items.source:
Exception that represents a transaction failure caused by a heuristic
decision on the side of the transaction coordinator.
items.translation: 表示由事务协调器侧的启发式决策导致的事务失败的异常。

items.source:
Sub-interface implemented by bean factories that can be part
of a hierarchy.
items.translation: 由可以作为层次结构一部分的 Bean 工厂实现的子接口。

items.source:
Sub-interface of MessageSource to be implemented by objects that
can resolve messages hierarchically.
items.translation: 可分层解析消息的对象的 MessageSource 子接口。

items.source: Superclass for tags that output content that might get HTML-escaped.
items.translation: 用于输出内容可能会被 HTML 转义的标签的超类。

items.source: Exception thrown when an HTTP 4xx is received.
items.translation: 收到 HTTP 4xx 响应时抛出异常。

items.source:
Represents an HTTP cookie as a name-value pair consistent with the content of
the "Cookie" request header.
items.translation: 表示为与"Cookie"请求头内容一致的名称 - 值对的 HTTP Cookie。

items.source: Represents an HTTP request or response entity, consisting of headers and body.
items.translation: 表示一个 HTTP 请求或响应实体，由标头和正文组成。

items.source:
Annotation to declare a method on an HTTP service interface as an HTTP
endpoint.
items.translation: 用于声明 HTTP 服务接口上的方法为 HTTP 端点的注解。

items.source:
Lowest level contract for reactive HTTP request handling that serves as a
common denominator across different runtimes.
items.translation: 用于处理响应式 HTTP 请求的最低级别合约，作为不同运行时之间的通用基础。

items.source:
A data structure representing HTTP request or response headers, mapping String
header names to a list of String values and also offering accessors for common
application-level data types.
items.translation: 一种表示 HTTP 请求或响应头的数据结构，将 String 类型的头名称映射到 String 值列表，并提供对常见应用级数据类型的访问器。

items.source: Abstract base for exceptions related to media types.
items.translation: 与媒体类型相关的异常的抽象基类。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the request handler cannot generate a response that is
acceptable by the client.
items.translation: 当请求处理器无法生成客户端可接受的响应时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a client POSTs, PUTs, or PATCHes content of a type
not supported by request handler.
items.translation: 当客户端 POST、PUT 或 PATCH 请求处理程序不支持的内容类型时，会抛出异常。

items.source: Represents the base interface for HTTP request and response messages.
items.translation: 表示 HTTP 请求和响应消息的基接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for converting from and to HTTP requests and responses.
items.translation: 用于将 HTTP 请求和响应进行转换的策略接口。

items.source: Represents an HTTP request method.
items.translation: 表示一个 HTTP 请求方法。

items.source:
Plain handler interface for components that process HTTP requests,
analogous to a Servlet.
items.translation: 用于处理 HTTP 请求的组件的普通处理器接口，类似于 Servlet。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a request handler does not support a
specific request method.
items.translation: 当请求处理器不支持特定请求方法时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when an HTTP 5xx is received.
items.translation: 收到 HTTP 5xx 错误时抛出异常。

items.source: Enum to specify the client type to use for an HTTP Service group.
items.translation: 枚举，用于指定 HTTP 服务组要使用的客户端类型。

items.source: Adapter that helps to configure a group independent of its client builder type.
items.translation: 帮助配置组且独立于其客户端构建器类型的适配器。

items.source: Callback to configure the client for a given group.
items.translation: 用于为给定组配置客户端的回调。

items.source: Contract to help iterate and configure the set of groups.
items.translation: 合同用于帮助迭代和配置组集。

items.source: Callback to provide the client builder rather than customize it.
items.translation: 回调以提供客户端构建器，而不是对其进行自定义。

items.source: Enumeration of HTTP status codes.
items.translation: HTTP 状态码枚举。

items.source: Enumeration of HTTP status series.
items.translation: HTTP 状态系列枚举。

items.source: Represents an HTTP response status code.
items.translation: 表示 HTTP 响应状态码。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS IllegalStateException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS 的 IllegalStateException。

items.source:
Exception thrown when the existence or non-existence of a transaction
amounts to an illegal state according to the transaction propagation
behavior that applies.
items.translation: 当事务的存在或不存在根据适用的事务传播行为构成非法状态时，抛出异常。

items.source: Representation of an import that has been processed during the parsing process.
items.translation: 解析过程中已处理的导入的表示。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a result set did not have the correct column count,
for example when expecting a single column but getting 0 or more than 1 column.
items.translation: 当结果集没有正确的列数时抛出数据访问异常，例如期望单列但得到 0 列或多于 1 列。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a result was not of the expected size,
for example when expecting a single row but getting 0 or more than 1 rows.
items.translation: 当结果的大小不符合预期时抛出数据访问异常，例如期望获取单行但实际得到 0 行或多于 1 行。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when something unintended appears to have
happened with an update, but the transaction hasn't already been rolled back.
items.translation: 更新操作出现意外情况时抛出数据访问异常，但事务尚未回滚。

items.source:
An index accessor is able to read from and possibly write to an indexed
structure of a target object.
items.translation: 索引访问器能够读取并可能写入目标对象的索引结构。

items.source:
Auto-proxy creator that considers infrastructure Advisor beans only,
ignoring any application-defined Advisors.
items.translation: 仅考虑基础设施 Advisor 的自动代理创建器，忽略任何应用程序定义的 Advisor。

items.source: A single injected element.
items.translation: 一个注入的元素。

items.source:
A simple descriptor for an injection point, pointing to a method/constructor
parameter or a field.
items.translation: 用于指向方法/构造函数参数或字段的简单注入点描述符。

items.source: Represent a list in an expression, for example, '{1,2,3}'.
items.translation: 在表达式中表示列表，例如，'{1,2,3}'。

items.source: Represent a map in an expression, for example, '{name:'foo',age:12}'.
items.translation: 在表达式中表示一个映射，例如，'{name:'foo',age:12}'。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by Spring AOP Advisors wrapping AspectJ
aspects that may have a lazy initialization strategy.
items.translation: 由 Spring AOP Advisor 实现的接口，用于包装可能具有懒初始化策略的 AspectJ 切面。

items.source: This interface represents a generic interceptor.
items.translation: 该接口表示一个通用的拦截器。

items.source: Helps with configuring a list of mapped interceptors.
items.translation: 有助于配置已映射拦截器的列表。

items.source: Generates new interfaces at runtime.
items.translation: 在运行时生成新接口。

items.source: Wrapper for a JSP or other resource within the same web application.
items.translation: 同一 Web 应用程序内 JSP 或其他资源的包装器。

items.source: Expression language AST node that represents an integer literal.
items.translation: 表示整数字面量的表达式语言 AST 节点。

items.source: Interface supplying the information necessary to describe an introduction.
items.translation: 提供描述简介所需信息的接口。

items.source:
Subinterface of AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor that allows additional interfaces
to be implemented by the interceptor, and available via a proxy using that
interceptor.
items.translation: AOP 联盟 MethodInterceptor 的子接口，允许拦截器实现额外的接口，并通过使用该拦截器的代理来访问这些接口。

items.source:
Exception raised when an API version cannot be parsed, or is not in the
supported version set.
items.translation: 当无法解析 API 版本或该版本不在支持的版本集合中时抛出异常。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidClientIDException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidClientIDException。

items.source:
Exception thrown on incorrect usage of the API, such as failing to
"compile" a query object that needed compilation before execution.
items.translation: 在错误使用 API 时抛出异常，例如在执行之前未对需要编译的查询对象进行“编译”。

items.source: Root for exceptions thrown when we use a data access resource incorrectly.
items.translation: 用于在使用数据访问资源不正确时抛出异常的根异常。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidDestinationException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidDestinationException。

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an invalid isolation level is specified,
i.e.
items.translation: 当指定了无效的隔离级别时抛出的异常，即

items.source: Exception thrown when referring to an invalid bean property.
items.translation: 引用无效的 Bean 属性时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a ResultSet has been accessed in an invalid fashion.
items.translation: 当以无效方式访问 ResultSet 时抛出异常。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS InvalidSelectorException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS InvalidSelectorException。

items.source:
Exception that gets thrown when an invalid timeout is specified,
that is, the specified timeout valid is out of range or the
transaction manager implementation doesn't support timeouts.
items.translation: 当指定了无效的超时时间时抛出的异常，即指定的超时值超出范围或事务管理器实现不支持超时。

items.source: Thrown when a URL string cannot be parsed.
items.translation: 抛出无法解析 URL 字符串时。

items.source: This interface represents an invocation in the program.
items.translation: 该接口表示程序中的调用。

items.source:
Thrown when an invocation on an MBean resource failed with an exception (either
a reflection exception or an exception thrown by the target method itself).
items.translation: 当对 MBean 资源的调用因异常（无论是反射异常还是目标方法本身抛出的异常）而失败时抛出。

items.source:
DataSource that routes to one of various target DataSources based on the
current transaction isolation level.
items.translation: 根据当前事务隔离级别路由到各种目标 DataSource 之一的 DataSource。

items.source: Decode bytes into CBOR and convert to Objects with Jackson 3.x.
items.translation: 将字节解码为 CBOR 并使用 Jackson 3.x 转换为对象。

items.source: Base class providing support methods for Jackson 3.x encoding and decoding.
items.translation: 提供 Jackson 3.x 编码和解码支持方法的基类。

items.source: Message converter that uses Jackson 3.x to convert messages to and from JSON.
items.translation: 使用 Jackson 3.x 将消息转换为 JSON 并从中转换的消息转换器。

items.source: A Jackson 3.x codec for encoding and decoding SockJS messages.
items.translation: 用于编码和解码 SockJS 消息的 Jackson 3.x 编解码器。

items.source:
Decode a byte stream into Smile and convert to Objects with Jackson 3.x,
leveraging non-blocking parsing.
items.translation: 将字节流解码为 Smile 格式并使用非阻塞解析将其转换为对象，借助 Jackson 3.x。

items.source: A hint that describes the need for Java serialization at runtime.
items.translation: 描述运行时需要 Java 序列化的提示。

items.source: Encode from single value to a byte stream containing XML elements.
items.translation: 将单个值编码为包含 XML 元素的字节流。

items.source:
AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor for declarative cache
management using JSR-107 caching annotations.
items.translation: 使用 JSR-107 缓存注解进行声明式缓存管理的 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptor。

items.source: Model the base of JSR-107 cache operation through an interface contract.
items.translation: 通过接口契约对 JSR-107 缓存操作的基类进行建模。

items.source: A specification for RowMapper-mapped queries.
items.translation: RowMapper 映射查询的规范。

items.source: A specification for simple result queries.
items.translation: 简单结果查询的规范。

items.source: A statement specification for parameter bindings and query/update execution.
items.translation: 参数绑定和查询/更新执行的语句规范。

items.source: Interface specifying a basic set of JDBC operations.
items.translation: 指定基本 JDBC 操作的接口。

items.source: Convenient base class for JDBC-aware transaction objects.
items.translation: JDBC 感知事务对象的便捷基类。

items.source: Exception thrown when a JDBC update affects an unexpected number of rows.
items.translation: 当 JDBC 更新影响的行数与预期不符时抛出异常。

items.source: Factory to manage Jetty resources, i.e.
items.translation: 用于管理 Jetty 资源的工厂，即

items.source: Common configuration object for activating a JMS message endpoint.
items.translation: 用于激活 JMS 消息端点的通用配置对象。

items.source: Common JMS send and receive operations with various settings.
items.translation: 带有各种设置的常见 JMS 发送和接收操作。

items.source:
Base class for exception thrown by the framework whenever it
encounters a problem related to JMS.
items.translation: 框架在遇到任何与 JMS 相关的问题时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS JMSSecurityException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS 的 JMSSecurityException。

items.source: Helper class that simplifies synchronous JMS access code.
items.translation: 简化同步 JMS 访问代码的辅助类。

items.source: General base exception to be thrown on JMX errors.
items.translation: JMX 错误中要抛出的通用基异常。

items.source:
Convenient superclass for JNDI accessors, providing "jndiTemplate"
and "jndiEnvironment" bean properties.
items.translation: JNDI 访问器的便捷父类，提供 "jndiTemplate" 和 "jndiEnvironment" 属性。

items.source: Convenient superclass for classes that can locate any number of JNDI objects.
items.translation: 适用于可以定位任意数量 JNDI 对象的类的便捷父类。

items.source:
Convenient superclass for JNDI-based service locators,
providing configurable lookup of a specific JNDI resource.
items.translation: 基于 JNDI 的服务定位器的便捷父类，提供对特定 JNDI 资源的可配置查找。

items.source: Helper class that simplifies JNDI operations.
items.translation: 简化 JNDI 操作的辅助类。

items.source:
This interface represents a generic runtime joinpoint (in the AOP
terminology).
items.translation: 该接口表示一个通用的运行时连接点（在 AOP 术语中）。

items.source:
SPI strategy that encapsulates certain functionality that standard JPA 3.0 does
not offer, such as access to the underlying JDBC Connection.
items.translation: 封装了标准 JPA 3.0 未提供的某些功能（例如对底层 JDBC 连接的访问）的 SPI 策略。

items.source: JPA-specific subclass of ObjectRetrievalFailureException.
items.translation: ObjectRetrievalFailureException 的 JPA 专用子类。

items.source: JPA-specific subclass of ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException.
items.translation: ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException 的 JPA 专用子类。

items.source:
SPI interface that allows to plug in vendor-specific behavior
into Spring's EntityManagerFactory creators.
items.translation: 允许将特定于供应商的行为插入到 Spring 的 EntityManagerFactory 创建器中的 SPI 接口。

items.source: Strategy interface used to compare JSON strings.
items.translation: 用于比较 JSON 字符串的策略接口。

items.source: Modes that can be used to compare JSON.
items.translation: 可用于比较 JSON 的模式。

items.source: Comparison results.
items.translation: 比较结果。

items.source: Delegate to abstract JSON type conversion in AssertJ support clases.
items.translation: 将断言库支持类中的抽象 JSON 类型转换委托出去。

items.source:
AssertJ assertions that can be applied
to a JSON value produced by evaluating a JSON path
expression.
items.translation: 可应用于通过评估 JSON 路径表达式生成的 JSON 值的 AssertJ 断言。

items.source: Parser for the <tx:jta-transaction-manager/> XML configuration element.
items.translation: <tx:jta-transaction-manager/> XML 配置元素的解析器。

items.source: Cache key generator.
items.translation: 缓存键生成器。

items.source:
Interface for retrieving keys, typically used for auto-generated keys
as potentially returned by JDBC insert statements.
items.translation: 用于检索键的接口，通常由 JDBC 插入语句可能返回的自动生成的键使用。

items.source:
Base class providing support methods for encoding and decoding with Kotlin
serialization.
items.translation: 提供与 Kotlin 序列化进行编码和解码支持方法的基类。

items.source: A position in the bytecode of a method.
items.translation: 方法字节码中的一个位置。

items.source:
Proxy for a target DataSource, fetching actual JDBC Connections lazily,
i.e.
items.translation: 目标 DataSource 的代理，惰性获取实际的 JDBC 连接，即

items.source: A common interface defining methods for start/stop lifecycle control.
items.translation: 定义用于启动/停止生命周期控制的常用接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for processing Lifecycle beans within the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于在 ApplicationContext 中处理生命周期 Bean 的策略接口。

items.source: Exception to be thrown when the execution of a listener method failed.
items.translation: 当监听器方法执行失败时抛出的异常。

items.source: Simple factory for shared List instances.
items.translation: 用于共享 List 实例的简单工厂。

items.source: Common superclass for nodes representing literals (boolean, string, number, etc).
items.translation: 表示字面量（布尔值、字符串、数字等）的节点的通用父类。

items.source:
Interceptor that allows for changing the current locale on every request,
via a configurable request parameter (default parameter name: "locale").
items.translation: 允许通过可配置的请求参数（默认参数名称为"locale"）在每次请求时更改当前区域的拦截器。

items.source: Strategy interface for determining the current Locale.
items.translation: 用于确定当前区域的策略接口。

items.source:
Interface for web-based locale context resolution strategies that allows
for both locale context resolution via the request and locale context modification
via the HTTP exchange.
items.translation: 用于基于 Web 的区域上下文解析策略的接口，支持通过请求进行区域上下文解析以及通过 HTTP 交换进行修改。

items.source:
Interface for web-based locale resolution strategies that allows for
both locale resolution via the request and locale modification via
request and response.
items.translation: 用于基于 Web 的区域解析策略的接口，支持通过请求进行区域解析，以及通过请求和响应修改区域。

items.source: Expression language AST node that represents a long integer literal.
items.translation: 表示长整型字面量的表达式语言 AST 节点。

items.source:
Represents an override of a method that looks up an object in the same IoC context,
either by bean name or by bean type (based on the declared method return type).
items.translation: 表示对同一 IoC 上下文中查找对象的方法的重写，该查找可以通过 Bean 名称或 Bean 类型（基于声明的方法返回类型）进行。

items.source: Exception thrown on failed authentication.
items.translation: 认证失败时抛出异常。

items.source: Base class for all mail exceptions.
items.translation: 所有邮件异常的基类。

items.source:
This is a common interface for mail messages, allowing a user to set key
values required in assembling a mail message, without needing to know if
the underlying message is a simple text message or a more sophisticated
MIME message.
items.translation: 这是用于邮件消息的通用接口，允许用户设置组装邮件消息所需的关键值，而无需了解底层消息是简单的文本消息还是更复杂的 MIME 消息。

items.source: Exception thrown if illegal message properties are encountered.
items.translation: 遇到非法消息属性时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception to be thrown by user code if a mail cannot be prepared properly,
for example when a FreeMarker template cannot be rendered for the mail text.
items.translation: 用户代码在邮件无法正确准备时抛出的异常，例如当无法为邮件文本渲染 FreeMarker 模板时。

items.source: Exception thrown when a mail sending error is encountered.
items.translation: 遇到邮件发送错误时抛出异常。

items.source:
Tag collection class used to hold managed array elements, which may
include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
items.translation: 用于托管数组元素的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。

items.source: Metadata that indicates to expose a given bean property as JMX attribute.
items.translation: 指示将给定的 Bean 属性暴露为 JMX 属性的元数据。

items.source:
Strategy interface to filter the list of persistent managed types to include
in the persistence unit.
items.translation: 用于过滤要包含在持久化单元中的持久化管理类型列表的策略接口。

items.source:
Tag collection class used to hold managed List elements, which may
include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
items.translation: 用于托管 List 元素的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。

items.source:
Tag collection class used to hold managed Map values, which may
include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
items.translation: 用于存储托管 Map 值的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。

items.source:
Metadata that indicates to expose a given bean property as a JMX attribute,
with additional descriptor properties that indicate that the attribute is a
metric.
items.translation: 指示将给定的 Bean 属性暴露为 JMX 属性的元数据，并包含额外的描述符属性以表明该属性是一个指标。

items.source: Metadata that indicates a JMX notification emitted by a bean.
items.translation: 指示由 Bean 发出的 JMX 通知的元数据。

items.source: Metadata that indicates to expose a given method as JMX operation.
items.translation: 指示将给定方法暴露为 JMX 操作的元数据。

items.source: Metadata about JMX operation parameters.
items.translation: 关于 JMX 操作参数的元数据。

items.source:
Metadata indicating that instances of an annotated class
are to be registered with a JMX server.
items.translation: 指示已标注类的实例需注册到 JMX 服务器的元数据。

items.source:
Tag collection class used to hold managed Set values, which may
include runtime bean references (to be resolved into bean objects).
items.translation: 用于存储托管 Set 值的标签集合类，其中可能包含运行时 Bean 引用（需解析为 Bean 对象）。

items.source:
Map-based implementation of the BindingResult interface,
supporting registration and evaluation of binding errors on
Map attributes.
items.translation: 基于 Map 的 BindingResult 接口实现，支持在 Map 属性上注册和评估绑定错误。

items.source: Simple factory for shared Map instances.
items.translation: 用于共享 Map 实例的简单工厂。

items.source: Meta annotation that indicates a web mapping annotation.
items.translation: 指示 Web 映射注解的元注解。

items.source:
Reusable query in which concrete subclasses must implement the abstract
mapRow(ResultSet, int) method to convert each row of the JDBC ResultSet
into an object.
items.translation: 可重用的查询，其中具体的子类必须实现抽象的 `mapRow(ResultSet, int)` 方法，以将 JDBC `ResultSet` 的每一行转换为对象。

items.source:
Reusable RDBMS query in which concrete subclasses must implement
the abstract mapRow(ResultSet, int) method to map each row of
the JDBC ResultSet into an object.
items.translation: 可复用的关系型数据库管理系统查询，其中具体子类必须实现抽象的 `mapRow(ResultSet, int)` 方法，将 JDBC `ResultSet` 的每一行映射为对象。

items.source: Defines the contract for Object XML Mapping Marshallers.
items.translation: 定义了对象 XML 映射 Marshaller 的契约。

items.source: Base class for exception thrown when a marshalling or unmarshalling error occurs.
items.translation: 抛出序列化或反序列化错误时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Exception thrown on marshalling failure.
items.translation: 在反序列化失败时抛出异常。

items.source:
MultipartException subclass thrown when an upload exceeds the
maximum upload size allowed.
items.translation: 当上传超过允许的最大大小时，会抛出 MultipartException 子类异常。

items.source:
Thrown when an invocation failed because of an I/O problem on the
MBeanServerConnection.
items.translation: 当 MBeanServerConnection 上发生 I/O 问题导致调用失败时抛出此异常。

items.source: Exception thrown in case of failure when exporting an MBean.
items.translation: 导出 MBean 失败时抛出异常。

items.source:
Interface that defines the set of MBean export operations that are intended to be
accessed by application developers during application runtime.
items.translation: 定义了一组在应用程序运行时由应用程序开发人员访问的 MBean 导出操作的接口。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by all classes that can
create management interface metadata for a managed resource.
items.translation: 所有能够创建受管资源管理接口元数据的类都必须实现的接口。

items.source:
Thrown if an exception is encountered when trying to retrieve
MBean metadata.
items.translation: 在尝试检索 MBean 元数据时遇到异常时抛出。

items.source: Creates a proxy to a managed resource running either locally or remotely.
items.translation: 创建一个代理，用于访问在本地或远程运行的托管资源。

items.source:
Interface representing an object whose value set can be merged with
that of a parent object.
items.translation: 表示其值集可与父对象值集合并的对象接口。

items.source: A generic message representation with headers and body.
items.translation: 带有标头和正文的通用消息表示形式。

items.source: A registry for configuring message broker options.
items.translation: 用于配置消息代理选项的注册表。

items.source: Defines methods for sending messages.
items.translation: 定义用于发送消息的方法。

items.source: A strategy interface for formatting message codes.
items.translation: 用于格式化消息代码的策略接口。

items.source: Strategy interface for building message codes from validation error codes.
items.translation: 用于从验证错误代码构建消息代码的策略接口。

items.source: Contract for mapping conditions to messages.
items.translation: 用于将映射条件映射到消息的合约。

items.source: Strategy interface that specifies a converter between Java objects and JMS messages.
items.translation: 指定 Java 对象与 JMS 消息之间转换器的策略接口。

items.source: Exception that indicates an error occurred during message delivery.
items.translation: 指示消息传递期间发生错误的异常。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageEOFException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageEOFException。

items.source:
Annotation for handling exceptions thrown from message-handling methods within a
specific handler class.
items.translation: 用于处理特定处理器类中消息处理方法所抛出异常的注解。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageFormatException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageFormatException。

items.source: Exception that indicates an error occurred during message handling.
items.translation: 指示消息处理期间发生错误的异常。

items.source:
Message listener adapter that delegates the handling of messages to target
listener methods via reflection, with flexible message type conversion.
items.translation: 通过反射将消息处理委托给目标监听器方法的具有灵活消息类型转换的消息监听器适配器。

items.source:
Internal abstraction used by the framework representing a message
listener container.
items.translation: 框架内部用于表示消息监听器容器的抽象。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageNotReadableException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageNotReadableException。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS MessageNotWriteableException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMS MessageNotWriteableException。

items.source: Operations for receiving messages from a destination.
items.translation: 用于从目的地接收消息的操作。

items.source: Operations for sending messages to and receiving the reply from a destination.
items.translation: 向目的地发送消息并接收回复的操作。

items.source: Operations for sending messages to a destination.
items.translation: 向目的地发送消息的操作。

items.source:
Strategy interface for resolving messages, with support for the parameterization
and internationalization of such messages.
items.translation: 用于解析消息的策略接口，支持此类消息的参数化和国际化。

items.source:
Represents a Spring-managed bean with cross-cutting functionality to be
applied to one or more Spring beans with annotation-based message
handling methods.
items.translation: 表示一个由 Spring 管理的 Bean，具有切面功能，可应用于一个或多个带有基于注解的消息处理方法（annotation-based message handling methods）的 Spring Bean。

items.source: The base exception for any failures related to messaging.
items.translation: 与消息传递相关的任何失败的基异常。

items.source: Exception indicating that something went wrong during JDBC meta-data lookup.
items.translation: 指示在 JDBC 元数据查找期间发生错误的异常。

items.source: A ConversionNotSupportedException raised while resolving a method argument.
items.translation: 解析方法参数时抛出 ConversionNotSupportedException。

items.source: Exception that indicates that a method argument has not the expected type.
items.translation: 指示方法参数未具有预期类型的异常。

items.source: A TypeMismatchException raised while resolving a controller method argument.
items.translation: 在解析控制器方法参数时抛出 TypeMismatchException。

items.source: Advice invoked before a method is invoked.
items.translation: 在方法调用之前调用的 Advice。

items.source: Intercepts calls on an interface on its way to the target.
items.translation: 拦截目标接口上的调用，在调用到达目标之前。

items.source: A callback interface for metadata lookup on a given method.
items.translation: 用于在给定方法上查找元数据的回调接口。

items.source:
Description of an invocation to a method, given to an interceptor
upon method-call.
items.translation: 描述在方法调用时提供给拦截器的方法调用。

items.source:
Thrown when a bean property getter or setter method throws an exception,
analogous to an InvocationTargetException.
items.translation: 当 Bean 属性的 getter 或 setter 方法抛出异常时抛出，类似于 InvocationTargetException。

items.source:
Helper class that allows for specifying a method to invoke in a declarative
fashion, be it static or non-static.
items.translation: 允许以声明方式指定要调用的方法（无论是静态还是非静态）的辅助类。

items.source: Quartz Job implementation that invokes a specified method.
items.translation: 调用指定方法的 Quartz 作业实现。

items.source: Extension of the MethodInvokingJob, implementing the StatefulJob interface.
items.translation: 扩展了 MethodInvokingJob 并实现了 StatefulJob 接口。

items.source:
Interface that defines abstract access to the annotations of a specific
method, in a form that does not require that method's class to be loaded yet.
items.translation: 定义了对特定方法的注解的抽象访问接口的形式，无需先加载该方法的类。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 405 (method not allowed).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 405（方法不允许）的错误的异常。

items.source:
Object representing the override of a method on a managed object by the IoC
container.
items.translation: 由 IoC 容器表示对托管对象上方法的重写的对象。

items.source:
Set of method overrides, determining which, if any, methods on a
managed object the Spring IoC container will override at runtime.
items.translation: 方法覆盖集合，用于确定 Spring IoC 容器在运行时将覆盖托管对象上的哪些（如果有的话）方法。

items.source: Helper class that encapsulates the specification of a method parameter, i.e.
items.translation: 封装方法参数规范的辅助类，即

items.source:
A reference to a method with convenient code generation for
referencing, or invoking it.
items.translation: 对具有便捷代码生成功能以引用或调用它的方法的引用。

items.source:
Expression language AST node that represents a method reference (i.e., a
method invocation other than a simple property reference).
items.translation: 表示方法引用（即非简单属性引用的方法调用）的表达式语言 AST 节点。

items.source: Strategy for generating code for arguments based on their type.
items.translation: 基于参数类型生成代码的策略。

items.source: Contract to apply method validation and handle the results.
items.translation: 用于应用方法验证并处理结果的契约。

items.source: A visitor to visit a Java method.
items.translation: 访问 Java 方法的访客。

items.source:
Represents a container for MIME attachments
Concrete implementations might adapt a SOAPMessage or an email message.
items.translation: 表示 MIME 附件的容器。具体实现可能会适配 SOAPMessage 或电子邮件消息。

items.source:
Represents a MIME Type, as originally defined in RFC 2046 and subsequently
used in other Internet protocols including HTTP.
items.translation: 表示 MIME 类型，该类型最初在 RFC 2046 中定义，随后在其他互联网协议（包括 HTTP）中使用。

items.source: Exception raised when an API version is required, but is not present.
items.translation: 当需要 API 版本但未提供时抛出的异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when required properties are not found.
items.translation: 当找不到必需属性时抛出异常。

items.source:
Signals the part of a "multipart/form-data" request, identified by name
could not be found.
items.translation: 标识为名称的 "multipart/form-data" 请求部分未找到。

items.source: Reset strategy used on a mock bean.
items.translation: 在模拟 Bean 上使用的重置策略。

items.source: Request builder exposing properties not related to the body.
items.translation: 暴露与主体无关属性的请求构建器。

items.source: A builder that adds a body to the request.
items.translation: 一个用于向请求添加主体的构建器。

items.source: Interface that defines a holder for model attributes.
items.translation: 定义模型属性持有者的接口。

items.source: Holder for both Model and View in the web MVC framework.
items.translation: Web MVC 框架中用于同时持有 Model 和 View 的组件。

items.source:
Annotation that binds a method parameter or method return value
to a named model attribute, exposed to a web view.
items.translation: 绑定方法参数或方法返回值到命名模型属性的注解，该属性暴露给 Web 视图。

items.source: Builder that allows for further customization of part headers.
items.translation: 允许进一步自定义部件标题的 Builder。

items.source: Exception thrown when multipart resolution fails.
items.translation: 当多部分解析失败时抛出异常。

items.source: A representation of an uploaded file received in a multipart request.
items.translation: 多部分请求中接收到的上传文件的表示。

items.source:
Provides additional methods for dealing with multipart content within a
servlet request, allowing to access uploaded files.
items.translation: 为处理 Servlet 请求中的多部分内容提供额外方法，允许访问上传的文件。

items.source:
This interface defines the multipart request access operations that are exposed
for actual multipart requests.
items.translation: 该接口定义了实际多部分请求所暴露的多部分请求访问操作。

items.source: Support class for multipart HTTP message writers.
items.translation: 支持多部分 HTTP 消息写入器的支持类。

items.source: Provides access to the result of an executed request.
items.translation: 提供已执行请求结果的访问权限。

items.source: Builder class to create URLs for method arguments.
items.translation: 用于创建方法参数 URL 的 Builder 类。

items.source: Method invocation information.
items.translation: 方法调用信息。

items.source: A simple holder for a given bean name plus bean instance.
items.translation: 给定 Bean 名称和 Bean 实例的简单持有器。

items.source:
Interface specifying a basic set of JDBC operations allowing the use
of named parameters rather than the traditional '?' placeholders.
items.translation: 定义了一组基本 JDBC 操作的接口，允许使用命名参数而非传统的'?'占位符。

items.source:
Template class with a basic set of JDBC operations, allowing the use
of named parameters rather than traditional '?' placeholders.
items.translation: 包含一组基本 JDBC 操作的模板类，允许使用命名参数而非传统的'?'占位符。

items.source:
Pointcut bean for simple method name matches, as an alternative to regular
expression patterns.
items.translation: 用于简单方法名匹配的切点 Bean，作为正则表达式模式的替代方案。

items.source:
Convenient class for name-match method pointcuts that hold an Advice,
making them an Advisor.
items.translation: 用于名称匹配方法切面的便捷类，它持有 Advice 并将其转换为 Advisor。

items.source:
Exception thrown when attempting to work with a nested transaction
but nested transactions are not supported by the underlying backend.
items.translation: 尝试处理嵌套事务时抛出异常，但底层后端不支持嵌套事务。

items.source:
Root of the hierarchy of data access exceptions that are considered non-transient -
where a retry of the same operation would fail unless the cause of the Exception
is corrected.
items.translation: 数据访问异常层次结构中表示非瞬态异常的根节点——除非修正了异常的原因，否则重试同一操作将会失败。

items.source: Data access exception thrown when a resource fails completely and the failure is permanent.
items.translation: 资源完全失败且该失败为永久性时，会抛出数据访问异常。

items.source: Exception thrown when a message can't be resolved.
items.translation: 消息无法解析时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception raised when an API version is valid, but did not match the versions
declared in request mappings for the endpoint.
items.translation: 当 API 版本有效但与端点请求映射中声明的版本不匹配时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 406 (not acceptable).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 406（不可接受）错误的异常。

items.source:
Extension of AopConfigException thrown when trying to perform
an advisor generation operation on a class that is not an
AspectJ annotation-style aspect.
items.translation: 抛出 `AopConfigException` 扩展，当尝试对非 AspectJ 注解风格的类执行顾问生成操作时。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an operation is attempted that
relies on an existing transaction (such as setting
rollback status) and there is no existing transaction.
items.translation: 当尝试执行依赖于现有事务的操作（例如设置回滚状态）且不存在现有事务时，会抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to get the value of a property
that isn't readable, because there's no getter method.
items.translation: 在尝试获取没有 getter 方法的不可读属性的值时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown on an attempt to set the value of a property that
is not writable (typically because there is no setter method).
items.translation: 在尝试设置不可写属性的值时抛出异常（通常是因为没有 setter 方法）。

items.source: Expression language AST node that represents null.
items.translation: 表示 null 的表达式语言 AST 节点。

items.source: Constants that indicate nullness, as well as related utility methods.
items.translation: 表示空值以及相关实用方法的常量。

items.source:
Exception thrown when navigation of a valid nested property
path encounters a NullPointerException.
items.translation: 在导航有效的嵌套属性路径时抛出空指针异常。

items.source: Declares that a field or method parameter should be formatted as a number.
items.translation: 声明字段或方法参数应格式化为数字。

items.source: Common number format styles.
items.translation: 通用数字格式样式。

items.source: A general-purpose number formatter using NumberFormat's number style.
items.translation: 使用 NumberFormat 数字样式的一般用途数字格式化程序。

items.source:
Encapsulates an object error, that is, a global reason for rejecting
an object.
items.translation: 封装对象错误，即拒绝该对象的全球性原因。

items.source:
Defines a factory which can return an Object instance
(possibly shared or independent) when invoked.
items.translation: 定义一个工厂，在调用时返回一个对象实例（可能是共享的或独立的）。

items.source: Exception thrown on an optimistic locking violation for a mapped object.
items.translation: 在映射对象上因乐观锁冲突而抛出异常。

items.source: Exception thrown if a mapped object could not be retrieved via its identifier.
items.translation: 如果无法通过标识符检索映射对象，则抛出异常。

items.source:
Filter base class that aims to guarantee a single execution per request
dispatch, on any servlet container.
items.translation: 旨在保证在任意 Servlet 容器中每个请求分发仅执行一次的 Filter 基类。

items.source: Represents the boolean AND operation.
items.translation: 表示布尔 AND 运算。

items.source: The JVM opcodes, access flags and array type codes.
items.translation: JVM 操作码、访问标志和数组类型代码。

items.source: Decrement operator.
items.translation: 递减运算符。

items.source: Implements division operator.
items.translation: 实现除法运算符。

items.source:
Servlet Filter that binds a JPA EntityManager to the thread for the
entire processing of the request.
items.translation: 绑定 JPA EntityManager 到线程的 Servlet Filter，用于整个请求处理过程。

items.source:
Spring web request interceptor that binds a JPA EntityManager to the
thread for the entire processing of the request.
items.translation: 用于在整个请求处理过程中将 JPA EntityManager 绑定到线程的 Spring Web 请求拦截器。

items.source: Implements the equality operator.
items.translation: 实现相等运算符。

items.source: Common supertype for operators that operate on either one or two operands.
items.translation: 用于操作一个或两个操作数的运算符的通用基类型。

items.source:
A descriptor comparison encapsulates the result of comparing descriptor
for two operands and describes at what level they are compatible.
items.translation: 描述符比较封装了对两个操作数的描述符比较结果，并描述了它们兼容的级别。

items.source: Implements the matches operator.
items.translation: 实现匹配运算符。

items.source: Represents a NOT operation.
items.translation: 表示非运算。

items.source: The power operator.
items.translation: 幂运算符。

items.source: Implements greater-than-or-equal operator.
items.translation: 实现大于等于运算符。

items.source: Implements the greater-than operator.
items.translation: 实现大于运算符。

items.source: Increment operator.
items.translation: 自增运算符。

items.source: Implements the less-than-or-equal operator.
items.translation: 实现小于或等于运算符。

items.source: Implements the less-than operator.
items.translation: 实现小于运算符。

items.source: Implements the modulus operator.
items.translation: 实现取模运算符。

items.source: Implements the not-equal operator.
items.translation: 实现不等于运算符。

items.source: Represents the boolean OR operation.
items.translation: 表示布尔或运算。

items.source:
The plus operator will:

add numbers
concatenate strings
items.translation:
加号运算符将：
- 对数字进行加法运算
- 对字符串进行连接

items.source: Exception thrown on an optimistic locking violation.
items.translation: 在乐观锁冲突时抛出异常。

items.source: Strategy interface to provide an order source for a given object.
items.translation: 用于为给定对象提供订单源的 Strategy 接口。

items.source: Strategy that resolves the requested content type from a query parameter.
items.translation: 从查询参数解析请求内容类型的策略。

items.source:
Trivial controller that always returns a pre-configured view and optionally
sets the response status code.
items.translation: 一个总是返回预配置视图的简单控制器，并可选择设置响应状态码。

items.source:
Implement this interface when parameters need to be customized based
on the connection.
items.translation: 在需要根据连接自定义参数时，实现此接口。

items.source: Interface to discover parameter names for methods and constructors.
items.translation: 用于发现方法和构造函数参数名称的接口。

items.source: Store and expose the results of method validation for a method parameter.
items.translation: 存储并暴露方法参数的方法验证结果。

items.source: Holds information about a parsed SQL statement.
items.translation: 包含已解析的 SQL 语句的信息。

items.source: Represent an exception that occurs during expression parsing.
items.translation: 表示在表达式解析期间发生的异常。

items.source: Parses text strings to produce instances of T.
items.translation: 将文本字符串解析以生成 T 的实例。

items.source:
Context that gets passed along a bean definition parsing process,
encapsulating all relevant configuration as well as state.
items.translation: 在 Bean 定义解析过程中传递的上下文，封装了所有相关的配置以及状态。

items.source:
Input provided to an expression parser that can influence an expression
parsing/compilation routine.
items.translation: 输入到表达式解析器的内容，该解析器能够影响表达式解析/编译过程。

items.source: Representation for a part in a "multipart/form-data" request.
items.translation: “multipart/form-data”请求中部分的表示。

items.source: A path element, either separator or path segment.
items.translation: 路径元素，即分隔符或路径段。

items.source: Options to customize parsing based on the type of input path.
items.translation: 根据输入路径类型自定义解析的选项。

items.source: Path segment element.
items.translation: 路径段元素。

items.source: Path separator element.
items.translation: 路径分隔符元素。

items.source: Configure path matching options.
items.translation: 配置路径匹配选项。

items.source: Representation of a parsed path pattern.
items.translation: 解析路径模式的表示。

items.source:
Holder for URI variables and path parameters (matrix variables) extracted
based on the pattern for a given matched path.
items.translation: 用于存储根据给定匹配路径的模式提取的 URI 变量和路径参数（矩阵变量）的持有者。

items.source: Holder for the result of a match on the start of a pattern.
items.translation: 匹配模式开头匹配结果的持有者。

items.source: Exception that is thrown when there is a problem with the pattern being parsed.
items.translation: 解析模式出现问题时抛出的异常。

items.source: A formatter for number values in percent style.
items.translation: 用于百分比样式的数值格式化程序。

items.source:

Exception for errors that fit response status 400 (bad request) for use in

items.translation: 适用于 Spring Web 应用程序的、用于响应状态码为 400（请求无效）错误的异常。

Exporter that takes Spring-defined objects and exposes them as

(and optionally the query string) to the ServletContext log.

ResourceLoader implementation that resolves paths as ServletContext

in an HttpServletBean or GenericFilterBean subclass).
items.translation: 用于在 WebApplicationContext 之外（例如，在 HttpServletBean 或 GenericFilterBean 子类中）将路径解析为 ServletContext 资源的 ResourceLoader 实现。

Fatal binding exception, thrown when we want to treat binding exceptions as
unrecoverable.
items.translation: 致命绑定异常，在我们将绑定异常视为不可恢复时抛出。

items.source:
Servlet-specific subclass of RequestHandledEvent,
adding servlet-specific context information.
items.translation: RequestHandledEvent 的 Servlet 专用子类，添加了 Servlet 专用的上下文信息。

UriComponentsBuilder with additional static factory methods to create links
based on the current HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 带有基于当前 HttpServletRequest 创建链接的附加静态工厂方法的 UriComponentsBuilder。

Spring Controller implementation that wraps a servlet instance which it manages
internally.
items.translation: 由 Spring 管理内部 servlet 实例的 Spring Controller 实现。

items.translation: 用于在后台会话中存储模型属性的策略接口。

items.translation: 已连接事件表示服务器对客户端连接请求的响应。

items.source:
Event raised when a new WebSocket client using a Simple Messaging Protocol
(for example, STOMP) as the WebSocket sub-protocol issues a connect request.
items.translation: 当使用简单消息协议（例如 STOMP）作为 WebSocket 子协议的新的 WebSocket 客户端发出连接请求时，会触发此事件。

items.source:
Event raised when the session of a WebSocket client using a Simple Messaging
Protocol (for example, STOMP) as the WebSocket sub-protocol is closed.
items.translation: 当使用简单消息协议（例如 STOMP）作为 WebSocket 子协议的 WebSocket 客户端会话关闭时触发的事件。

items.source:
Simple interface that can be injected into handler methods, allowing them to
signal that their session processing is complete.
items.translation: 可注入到处理器方法的简单接口，允许它们发出信号表明其会话处理已完成。

items.source:
Event raised when a new WebSocket client using a Simple Messaging Protocol
(for example, STOMP) sends a subscription request.
items.translation: 当使用简单消息协议（例如 STOMP）的新 WebSocket 客户端发送订阅请求时，会触发此事件。

items.source:
Event raised when a new WebSocket client using a Simple Messaging Protocol
(for example, STOMP) sends a request to remove a subscription.
items.translation: 当使用简单消息协议（例如 STOMP）的新 WebSocket 客户端发送移除订阅的请求时，会触发此事件。

items.source: Simple factory for shared Set instances.
items.translation: 用于共享 Set 实例的简单工厂。

items.source:
ClassLoader decorator that shadows an enclosing ClassLoader,
applying registered transformers to all affected classes.
items.translation: 用于遮蔽外围 ClassLoader 的 ClassLoader 装饰器，将已注册的转换器应用于所有受影响的类。

items.source:
A representation of a method signature, containing the method name,
return type, and parameter types.
items.translation: 方法签名的表示，包含方法名、返回类型和参数类型。

items.source:
A wrapper class for access to attributes associated with a SiMP session
(for example, WebSocket session).
items.translation: 用于访问与 SiMP 会话（例如，WebSocket 会话）相关联属性的包装类。

items.source: Simple cache manager working against a given collection of caches.
items.translation: 针对给定的一组缓存工作的简单缓存管理器。

items.translation: 适用于 BeanFactory 的简单对象实例化策略。

items.source:
A SimpleJdbcCall is a multithreaded, reusable object representing a call
to a stored procedure or a stored function.
items.translation: SimpleJdbcCall 是一个多线程、可复用的对象，代表对存储过程或存储函数的调用。

items.source:
Models a simple mail message, including data such as the from, to, cc, subject,
and text fields.
items.translation: 模拟简单的邮件消息，包括发件人、收件人、抄送、主题和正文等数据字段。

items.source:
A simple converter that simply unwraps the message payload as long as it matches the
expected target class.
items.translation: 一个简单的转换器，只要消息负载与预期的目标类匹配，就会简单地将其解包。

items.source:
ClassLoader that can be used to load classes without bringing them
into the parent loader.
items.translation: 可用于加载类而无需将其引入父加载器的 ClassLoader。

items.source:
A base class for working with message headers in simple messaging protocols that
support basic messaging patterns.
items.translation: 用于支持基本消息模式的简单消息协议中处理消息头的基类。

items.source:
A generic representation of different kinds of messages found in simple messaging
protocols like STOMP.
items.translation: 简单消息协议（如 STOMP）中不同种类消息的通用表示。

items.source: Represents a session of connected user.

items.source: A strategy for matching subscriptions.
items.translation: 用于匹配订阅的策略。

items.source: Represents a connected user.
items.translation: 代表已连接的用户。

items.source: A registry of currently connected users.
items.translation: 当前已连接用户的注册表。

items.source:
An implementation of the DataSourceLookup that simply wraps a
single given DataSource, returned for any data source name.
items.translation: 一种 DataSourceLookup 的实现，它简单地包装单个给定的 DataSource，并针对任何数据源名称返回该数据源。

items.source: Interface that defines a registry for shared bean instances.
items.translation: 定义共享 Bean 实例注册表的接口。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by transaction objects that are able to
return an internal rollback-only marker, typically from another
transaction that has participated and marked it as rollback-only.
items.translation: 由能够返回内部回滚标记的事务对象实现的接口，该标记通常来自另一个已参与并标记为仅回滚的事务。

items.source:
Provides additional information about a View such as whether it
performs redirects.
items.translation: 提供有关视图的附加信息，例如该视图是否执行重定向。

items.source: Base class for exceptions raised while processing SockJS HTTP requests.
items.translation: 处理 SockJS HTTP 请求时抛出的异常的基类。

items.source: Represents a SockJS frame.
items.translation: 表示一个 SockJS 帧。

items.source:
Applies a transport-specific format to the content of a SockJS frame resulting
in a content that can be written out.
items.translation: 将特定传输格式应用于 SockJS 帧的内容，从而生成可写入的内容。

items.source: SockJS frame types.
items.translation: SockJS 帧类型。

items.source:
Encode and decode messages to and from a SockJS message frame,
essentially an array of JSON-encoded messages.
items.translation: 对 SockJS 消息帧进行编码和解码，本质上是一个由 JSON 编码消息组成的数组。

items.source:
An exception thrown when a message frame was successfully received over an HTTP POST
and parsed but one or more of the messages it contained could not be delivered to the
WebSocketHandler either because the handler failed or because the connection got
closed.
items.translation: 当通过 HTTP POST 成功接收并解析消息帧，但其中一条或多条消息无法投递到 WebSocketHandler（因为处理器失败或连接已关闭）时抛出的异常。

items.source: The main entry point for processing HTTP requests from SockJS clients.
items.translation: 处理来自 SockJS 客户端的 HTTP 请求的主要入口点。

items.source:
Indicates a serious failure that occurred in the SockJS implementation as opposed to
in user code (for example, IOException while writing to the response).
items.translation: 指示在 SockJS 实现中发生的严重故障，而不是在用户代码中（例如，向响应写入时发生 IOException）。

items.source: Definition for sorting bean instances by a property.
items.translation: 用于按属性对 Bean 实例进行排序的定义。

items.source:
Simple strategy allowing tools to control how source metadata is attached
to the bean definition metadata.
items.translation: 简单的策略，允许工具控制如何将源元数据附加到 Bean 定义元数据上。

items.source:
A SpelCompiler will take a regular parsed expression and create (and load) a class
containing byte code that does the same thing as that expression.
items.translation: SpelCompiler 将接收一个常规解析后的表达式，并创建（及加载）一个包含字节码的类，该类的功能与该表达式相同。

items.source:
Captures the possible configuration settings for a compiler that can be used
when evaluating expressions.
items.translation: 捕获可用于评估表达式时的编译器可能配置设置。

items.source: SpEL parser.
items.translation: SpEL 解析器。

items.translation: 包含 Spring 表达式语言可以生成的所有消息。

items.source: Message kinds.
items.translation: 消息类型。

items.source:
Represents a node in the abstract syntax tree (AST) for a parsed Spring
Expression Language (SpEL) expression.
items.translation: 代表解析后的 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 抽象语法树 (AST) 中的一个节点。

items.source:
The common supertype of all AST nodes in a parsed Spring Expression Language
format expression.
items.translation: 已解析的 Spring 表达式语言格式表达式中所有 AST 节点的通用超类型。

items.source: Configuration object for the SpEL expression parser.
items.translation: SpEL 表达式解析器的配置对象。

items.translation: 框架内部使用的通用工厂加载机制。

items.translation: 处理实例化工厂时发生失败的策略。

RdbmsOperation using a JdbcTemplate and representing an SQL-based

items.translation: 使用 JdbcTemplate 表示基于 SQL 的调用的 RdbmsOperation，例如存储过程或存储函数。

items.translation: 用于返回单行结果的查询的 SQL“函数”包装器。

items.translation: 表示基于 SQL 的操作（如查询或更新）的操作对象，而不是存储过程。

items.translation: 用于表示 SQL 参数定义的 Object。

items.translation: 可重用的表示 SQL 更新的运行对象。

items.translation: Spring MultipartHttpServletRequest 适配器，封装了 Servlet HttpServletRequest 及其 Part 对象。

items.translation: 基于标准 Jakarta WebSocket API 的 WebSocketClient。

items.source: Simple key/value association for storing step metadata.
items.translation: 用于存储步骤元数据的简单键/值关联。

items.source:
Convenient abstract superclass for static method matchers, which don't care
about arguments at runtime.
items.translation: 适用于静态方法匹配器的便捷抽象父类，这些匹配器不关心运行时的参数。

items.source: Convenient base class for Advisors that are also static pointcuts.
items.translation: 适用于也是静态切面的 Advisor 的便捷基类。

items.source: Base class for STOMP client implementations.
items.translation: STOMP 客户端实现的基类。

items.source: Represents a STOMP command.
items.translation: 表示一个 STOMP 命令。

items.source: Raised after a failure to encode or decode a STOMP message.
items.translation: 在无法对 STOMP 消息进行编码或解码后抛出。

create subscriptions and receive messages on those subscriptions.
items.translation: 表示一个 STOMP 会话，包含发送消息、创建订阅以及在这些订阅上接收消息的操作。

handling failures.
items.translation: 用于客户端 STOMP 会话生命周期事件的合同，包括会话建立时的回调以及传输或消息处理失败的通知。

items.translation: 该类为固定的一组键实现了一个简单的 String → int 映射。

items.translation: 支持 RFC 6455 中定义的子协议的 WebSocket 处理程序接口。

items.source:
Class to manage context meta-data used for the configuration
and execution of operations on a database table.
items.translation: 用于管理数据库表操作配置和执行过程中所用上下文元数据的类。

items.source: Holder of meta-data for a specific parameter that is used for table processing.
items.translation: 用于表处理特定参数的元数据持有者。

items.source: Minimal interface for exposing the target class behind a proxy.
items.translation: 用于暴露代理背后目标类的最小接口。

items.source: Strategy for types that access elements of specific target classes.
items.translation: 针对访问特定目标类元素的类型的策略。

items.source:
Implementations can create special target sources, such as pooling target
sources, for particular beans.
items.translation: 实现可以创建特殊的目标源，例如针对特定 Bean 的池化目标源。

items.source: Status of the task execution outcome.
items.translation: 任务执行结果的当前状态。

items.source: A contract for sending messages and managing a TCP connection.
items.translation: 用于发送消息和管理 TCP 连接的合同。

items.source:
A contract for managing lifecycle events for a TCP connection including
the handling of incoming messages.
items.translation: 用于管理 TCP 连接生命周期事件（包括入站消息处理）的合约。

items.source: A contract for establishing TCP connections.
items.translation: 用于建立 TCP 连接的合同。

items.source: Represents a ternary expression, for example: "someCheck()?true:false".
items.translation: 表示三元表达式，例如："someCheck()?true:false"。

items.source: Utility that can be used to dynamically compile and test Java source code.
items.translation: 可用于动态编译和测试 Java 源代码的工具。

items.source: Defines autowiring modes for parameters in a test constructor.
items.translation: 定义测试构造函数中参数的自动装配模式。

items.translation: 定义符合 Spring 规范的事务属性的接口。

Callback interface for stateless listening to transaction creation/completion steps
in a transaction manager.
items.translation: 用于在事务管理器中无状态监听事务创建/完成步骤的回调接口。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS TransactionInProgressException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMSTransactionInProgressException。

items.source:
Marker interface for Spring transaction manager implementations,
either traditional or reactive.
items.translation: Spring 事务管理器实现的标记接口，无论是传统还是响应式。

items.source: The phase in which a transactional event listener applies.
items.translation: 事务事件监听器应用的阶段。

items.source: Proxy factory bean for simplified declarative transaction handling.
items.translation: 用于简化声明式事务处理的代理工厂 Bean。

items.source: Runtime exception mirroring the JMS TransactionRolledBackException.
items.translation: 运行时异常，镜像了 JMSTransactionRolledBackException。

items.source:
Exception thrown when attempting to suspend an existing transaction
but transaction suspension is not supported by the underlying backend.
items.translation: 尝试挂起现有事务时抛出异常，但底层后端不支持事务挂起。

items.source: Interface for transaction synchronization callbacks.
items.translation: 事务同步回调的接口。

items.source:
Central delegate that manages resources and transaction synchronizations per
subscriber context.
items.translation: 负责按订户上下文管理资源和事务同步的中心委托。

Exception thrown when a general transaction system error is encountered,
like on commit or rollback.
items.translation: 当遇到通用事务系统错误时抛出异常，例如在提交或回滚时。

Template class that simplifies programmatic transaction demarcation and
transaction exception handling.
items.translation: 简化程序化事务界定和事务异常处理的模板类。

items.source:
Superclass for exceptions caused by inappropriate usage of
a Spring transaction API.
items.translation: 由不当使用 Spring 事务 API 引起的异常的超类。

items.source:

where a previously failed operation might be able to succeed when the operation
is retried without any intervention by application-level functionality.
items.translation: 数据访问异常层次结构中被视为瞬态的根——在此情况下，先前失败的操作用于重试时可能会成功，而无需应用程序级功能的任何干预。

items.source:
Data access exception thrown when a resource fails temporarily
and the operation can be retried.
items.translation: 资源暂时失败且操作可重试时抛出数据访问异常。

items.translation: 用于确定与其关联的任务的下一个执行时间的触发器对象的通用接口。

items.translation: 类型转换器可以在表达式求值期间，将不同遇到的类型之间的值进行转换。

items.source: Contextual descriptor about a type to convert from or to.
items.translation: 用于转换的类型的上下文描述符。

items.source: Holder for a typed String value.
items.translation: 用于存储带类型字符串值的持有器。

items.source: A hint that describes the need for reflection on a type.
items.translation: 描述需要反射类型的提示。

items.source: Implementers of this interface are expected to be able to locate types.
items.translation: 实现该接口的实现者应能够定位类型。

items.source:
Exception thrown on mismatch between Java type and database type:
for example on an attempt to set an object of the wrong type
in an RDBMS column.
items.translation: 在 Java 类型与数据库类型不匹配时抛出异常：例如，尝试在关系型数据库管理系统 (RDBMS) 列中设置错误类型的对象。

items.source: Exception thrown on a type mismatch when trying to set a bean property.
items.translation: 在尝试设置 Bean 属性时，因类型不匹配而抛出异常。

items.source:
The path to a type argument, wildcard bound, array element type, or static inner type within an
enclosing type.
items.translation: 类型参数、通配符边界、数组元素类型或包含类型内的静态内部类型的路径。

items.source:
Exception thrown when we are unable to register an MBean,
for example because of a naming conflict.
items.translation: 无法注册 MBean 时抛出异常，例如由于命名冲突。

items.source:
Normal superclass when we can't distinguish anything more specific
than "something went wrong with the underlying resource": for example,
an SQLException from JDBC we can't pinpoint more precisely.
items.translation: 当无法区分比“底层资源出现问题”更具体的情况时，使用普通的父类：例如，来自 JDBC 且无法精确定位的 SQLException。

items.source: JmsException to be thrown when no other matching subclass found.
items.translation: 当找不到其他匹配的子类时，将抛出 JmsException。

items.source: Exception that indicates that the cause cannot be distinguished further.
items.translation: 表示无法进一步区分原因的异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when we can't classify an SQLException into
one of our generic data access exceptions.
items.translation: 抛出异常的情况是我们无法将 SQLException 分类为通用数据访问异常之一时。

items.source:
Thrown when an attempt to commit a transaction resulted
in an unexpected rollback.
items.translation: 当尝试提交事务导致意外回滚时抛出。

items.source:
Exception thrown when an attempt is made to use an unsupported
Advisor or Advice type.
items.translation: 尝试使用不支持的 Advisor 或 Advice 类型时抛出异常。

items.source: Defines the contract for Object XML Mapping unmarshallers.
items.translation: 定义了对象 XML 映射反序列化器的契约。

items.source: Exception thrown on unmarshalling failure.
items.translation: 反序列化失败时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean depends on other beans or simple properties
that were not specified in the bean factory definition, although
dependency checking was enabled.
items.translation: 当 Bean 依赖于未在 Bean 工厂定义中指定的其他 Bean 或简单属性，且启用了依赖检查时抛出异常。

items.source: Exception for errors that fit response status 415 (unsupported media type).
items.translation: 适用于响应状态码 415（不支持的媒体类型）错误的异常。

items.source:
Reusable RDBMS query in which concrete subclasses must implement
the abstract updateRow(ResultSet, int, context) method to update each
row of the JDBC ResultSet and optionally map contents into an object.
items.translation: 可重用的 RDBMS 查询，其中具体的子类必须实现抽象的 `updateRow(ResultSet, int, context)` 方法，以更新 JDBC ResultSet 的每一行，并可选择将内容映射到对象。

items.source: Contract for fetching the number of affected rows.
items.translation: 用于获取受影响行数的合同。

items.source: Builder-style methods to prepare and expand a URI template with variables.
items.translation: 用于准备和扩展带有变量的 URI 模板的构建器风格方法。

items.source: Defines the contract for URI Template variables.
items.translation: 定义了 URI 模板变量的契约。

items.source: Defines methods for expanding a URI template with variables.
items.translation: 定义了使用变量扩展 URI 模板的方法。

items.source: Helper class for URL path matching.
items.translation: 用于 URL 路径匹配的辅助类。

items.source:
A strategy for resolving a "user" destination by translating it to one or more
actual destinations one per active user session.
items.translation: 一种通过将“用户”目的地解析为每个活动用户会话对应一个实际目的地的策略。

items.source:
Contains the result from parsing a "user" destination from a source message
and translating it to target destinations (one per active user session).
items.translation: 包含从源消息解析"user"目的地并将其转换为目标目的地（每个活动用户会话一个）的结果。

items.source:
Interceptor that checks the authorization of the current user via the
user's roles, as evaluated by HttpServletRequest's isUserInRole method.
items.translation: 通过用户的角色（由 HttpServletRequest 的 isUserInRole 方法评估）检查当前用户授权权限的拦截器。

items.source: Exception thrown on marshalling validation failure.
items.translation: 在反序列化验证失败时抛出异常。

items.source: A validator for application-specific objects.
items.translation: 用于特定应用程序对象的验证器。

items.source: Thrown when value code generation fails.
items.translation: 当值代码生成失败时抛出。

items.source: Code generator for a single value.
items.translation: 用于单个值的代码生成器。

items.source:
Strategy interface that can be used to implement code generation for a
particular value type.
items.translation: 可用于为特定值类型实现代码生成的策略接口。

items.source: A ValueRef for the null value.
items.translation: 表示空值的 ValueRef。

items.source: A ValueRef holder for a single value, which cannot be set.
items.translation: 单个值的 ValueRef 持有者，该值不可设置。

items.source:
Strategy that encapsulates value String styling algorithms
according to Spring conventions.
items.translation: 根据 Spring 约定封装了值 String 样式算法的策略。

items.source: A strategy for extracting and embedding a resource version in its URL path.
items.translation: 一种用于在 URL 路径中提取和嵌入资源版本的策略。

items.source:
A strategy to determine the version of a static resource and to apply and/or
extract it from the URL path.
items.translation: 一种用于确定静态资源版本并从 URL 路径中应用和/或提取该资源的策略。

items.source: MVC View for a web interaction.
items.translation: 用于 Web 交互的 MVC 视图。

items.source: Assist with the registration of a single view controller.
items.translation: 协助注册单个视图控制器。

items.source:
Assists with the registration of simple automated controllers pre-configured
with status code and/or a view.
items.translation: 协助注册预配置了状态代码和/或视图的简单自动化控制器。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by objects that can resolve views by name.
items.translation: 由能够按名称解析视图的对象实现的接口。

items.source: Interface to provide configuration for a web application.
items.translation: 用于为 Web 应用程序提供配置的接口。

items.source: SPI for resolving custom arguments for a specific handler method parameter.
items.translation: 用于解析特定处理器方法参数的自定义参数的 SPI。

items.source:
Non-blocking, reactive client to perform HTTP requests, exposing a fluent,
reactive API over underlying HTTP client libraries such as Reactor Netty.
items.translation: 非阻塞、响应式客户端，用于执行 HTTP 请求，并通过底层 HTTP 客户端库（如 Reactor Netty）暴露流式、响应式 API。

items.source: Exceptions that contain actual HTTP request data.
items.translation: 包含实际 HTTP 请求数据的异常。

items.source: Exceptions that contain actual HTTP response data.
items.translation: 包含实际 HTTP 响应数据的异常。

items.source:
Handler interceptor that checks the request for supported methods and a
required session and prepares the response by applying the configured
cache settings.
items.translation: 检查请求中是否支持相应的方法以及是否存在必需的会话，并通过应用配置的缓存设置来准备响应的 Handler 拦截器。

items.source: Contract for handling exceptions during web server exchange processing.
items.translation: 用于处理 Web 服务器交换过程中异常的合同。

items.source:
Contract for interception-style, chained processing of Web requests that may
be used to implement cross-cutting, application-agnostic requirements such
as security, timeouts, and others.
items.translation: 用于拦截式、链式处理 Web 请求的合约，可用于实现跨切面且与应用无关的需求（如安全性、超时等）。

items.source: The main class for Spring WebFlux configuration.
items.translation: Spring WebFlux 配置的主类。

items.source: Contract to handle a web request.
items.translation: 用于处理 Web 请求的合约。

items.source: This builder has two purposes:
items.translation: 该构建器有两个目的：

items.source: This is the main class providing the configuration behind the MVC Java config.
items.translation: 这是提供 MVC Java 配置背后配置的主类。

items.source: An abstract base class for configuring STOMP over WebSocket/SockJS endpoints.
items.translation: 用于配置基于 WebSocket/SockJS 的 STOMP 端点的抽象基类。

items.source: Generic interface for a web request.
items.translation: Web 请求的通用接口。

items.source:
Adapter that implements the Servlet HandlerInterceptor interface
and wraps an underlying WebRequestInterceptor.
items.translation: 实现 ServletHandlerInterceptor 接口并包装底层 WebRequestInterceptor 的适配器。

items.source: Interface for general web request interception.
items.translation: 用于拦截通用 Web 请求的接口。

items.source:
Main contract for using a server-side session that provides access to session
attributes across HTTP requests.
items.translation: 用于使用服务器端会话的主合同，该会话提供跨 HTTP 请求访问会话属性的功能。

items.source: Contract for reactive-style handling of a WebSocket session.
items.translation: 用于以反应式风格处理 WebSocket 会话的合约。

items.source: Contract for initiating a WebSocket request.
items.translation: 用于发起 WebSocket 请求的合约。

items.source: Configuration support for WebSocket request handling.
items.translation: WebSocket 请求处理的配置支持。

items.source: Represents a WebSocket extension as defined in the RFC 6455.
items.translation: 代表 RFC 6455 中定义的 WebSocket 扩展。

items.source: Handler for a WebSocket messages.
items.translation: WebSocket 消息处理器。

items.source: A handler for WebSocket messages and lifecycle events.
items.translation: WebSocket 消息和生命周期事件的处理程序。

items.source: Provides methods for configuring a WebSocket handler.
items.translation: 提供配置 WebSocket 处理器的方法。

items.source: Representation of a WebSocket message.
items.translation: WebSocket 消息的表示形式。

items.source: WebSocket message types.
items.translation: WebSocket 消息类型。

items.source: A SockJS session for use with the WebSocket transport.
items.translation: 用于与 WebSocket 传输配合使用的 SockJS 会话。

items.source: A service to delegate WebSocket-related HTTP requests to.
items.translation: 用于委派与 WebSocket 相关的 HTTP 请求的服务。

items.source: Represents a WebSocket session.
items.translation: 代表一个 WebSocket 会话。

items.source: A WebSocket session abstraction.
items.translation: WebSocket 会话抽象。

items.source: Configure the processing of messages received from and sent to WebSocket clients.
items.translation: 配置从 WebSocket 客户端接收和发送的消息处理。

items.source: Spec for expectations on the response body decoded to a List.
items.translation: 用于对解码为 List 的响应体进行期望验证的规范。

items.source: Base specification for setting up tests without a server.
items.translation: 用于在无服务器环境下设置测试的基础规范。

items.source: Specification for customizing router function configuration.
items.translation: 自定义路由器函数配置的规范。

items.source: Extended interface for a resource that supports writing to it.
items.translation: 支持向资源写入操作的资源的扩展接口。

items.source: Bean definition reader for XML bean definitions.
items.translation: XML Bean 定义读取器。

items.source: Root of the hierarchy of Object XML Mapping exceptions.
items.translation: Object XML 映射异常层次结构的根。

items.source: A helper class for applying assertions via XPath expressions.
items.translation: 用于通过 XPath 表达式应用断言的辅助类。

items.source:
XSLT-driven View that allows for response context to be rendered as the
result of an XSLT transformation.
items.translation: 由 XSLT 驱动的视图，允许将响应上下文渲染为 XSLT 转换的结果。

items.source: Strategy interface used to test if properties match.
items.translation: 用于测试属性是否匹配的 Strategy 接口。

items.source: Callback interface used to process the YAML parsing results.
items.translation: 用于处理 YAML 解析结果的回调接口。

items.source: Method to use for resolving resources.
items.translation: 用于解析资源的类方法。
